articleTitle: Tip clearance optical measurement for rotating blades
abstract: The radial tip clearance of engine blades is the distance of blade tip to casing, and the usual clearance is about 1-2mm. Generally there are many electromagnetic interferences in clearance environment, so the paper adopts an optical-fiber sensor to measure the tip clearance while the blades are rotating from lowest speed to the highest speed. With no touchable mode and less size, the sensor doesn't affect the work of status of engine. The sensor can efficiently eliminate the effect of tip surface reflectivity variation and light source fluctuation to measurement results; The sensor can also reduce the effect of inter-angle between the measured tip surface and sensor end surface to the results greatly.

articleTitle: The Risk Priority Number methodology for distribution priority of emergency logistics after earthquake disasters
abstract: Efficient distribution for emergency logistics is vital to alleviate the disaster impact after the occurrence of earthquake. This paper studies the distribution priority of different rescue resource. Using Risk Priority Number (RPN) methodology,a dynamic model for identifying the relief-demand urgency is built. In the new RPN model, the parameters are redefined and a set of weights are assigned to them. The calculation algorithm is presented. In the case study, the RPN is calculated to rank the order of priority of resource allocation and distribution for the affected areas. The simulation results indicate that the proposed method is effective and applicable.

articleTitle: Dynamic monitoring system based on RFID technology for workshop production
abstract: This article conducts the research on dynamic monitoring system based on RFID technology for workshop production. Foreground of the system uses Visual basic 6.0 to carry on the application procedure development, and its background carries on the data administration work with the management platform based on access database. Firstly, RFID module acquires the data in the work field. Then enterprise workers carry on the real-time processing, and keep the correspondence with the plan layer. Thus, the workers formulate production dispatching according to information received from up and below layers and feedback to the production workshop by order form. Plan completed information, production quality examination information, equipment information and so on are also fed back to upper information plan layer so as to instruct plan making. The system mainly completes production dispatching, quality control, report and some other works, which can achieve the function of workshop production dynamic monitoring.

articleTitle: Design of cleaning robot for swimming pools
abstract: In order to reduce labor intensity and realize automatic cleaning of swimming pools, a cleaning robot was developed. Technical specifications, composition and working principle of the robot were described; motion characteristics were analyzed; mechanical body, cleaning mechanism and control system were designed. Development of the robot provides a new type of equipment for the automatic cleaning of swimming pools, so the design has important theoretical and practical value.

articleTitle: Bullwhip effect reduction in closed-loop supply chains using H-infinity control
abstract: In this paper, H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> robust control method is applied to operate closed-loop supply chains. Compare ability of H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> method to reduce bullwhip effect under two forecasting methods of market demand: Moving average and exponential smoothing. Numeric examples show H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> control can reduce bullwhip effect effectively in single period and whole periods.

articleTitle: REliable energy aware routing protocol in wireless sensor networks
abstract: In this paper, a novel energy-aware routing protocol is proposed and it is based on the reliability. Since in the wireless environment, the link quality is difficult to guarantee, the reliable routing protocol is a quite important issue to be studied. By using the local selection, path reservation and path delay broadcast, the new protocol reduce the re-transmission which is caused by the path failure. Furthermore, the performance of the new routing protocol is demonstrated by using the simulation results. From the simulation results, compared with other routing protocols, this protocol has the better performance on the aspects of saving energy and buffer.

articleTitle: Board characteristics and higher audit quality—Evidence from Chinsese listed companies
abstract: This paper seeks to investigate the empirical relationship between board characteristics and audit quality using OLS regression analysis. In this study, the paper uses audit fees as a proxy for audit quality and seeks to investigate whether board characteristics influence the extent of auditing, and consequently, the audit fee. The results show that board independence (proportion of external directors on the board of directors), board gender diversity (proportion of female directors on the board of directors) and board diligence (number of board meetings) are positively and significantly associated with audit fees, but board size (number of members on the board of directors) is negatively and significantly associated with audit fees. The results are consistent with the demand-based perspective of audit services, wherein firms with strong corporate governance demand additional assurance from the external auditors and higher audit quality, resulting in higher audit fees.

articleTitle: Application prospect of plastic heat exchanger in sewage source heat pump systems
abstract: According to the characteristics of domestic sewage water quality, PTFE pipe was chosen as the selected heat exchanger material by the comparison of metal and plastic materials, in order to overcome the main problems of the application of the heat exchanger in the sewage. The plastic heat exchanger as the research object, this paper analyzes the growth characteristics of fouling which is produced when the plastic heating exchangers are immersed in domestic sewage. The results show that PTFE could satisfy the use requirement of intensity and heat transfer. Plastic pipe has obvious advantages in corrosion-resistant, anti-fouling, and the investment price. Plastic pipe was a ideal material for making the heat exchanger.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of a one-unit system with finite vacations
abstract: This paper introduces finite vacations from a reliability theory viewpoint and deals with a one-unit repairable system with a repairman who takes finite vacations. A total probability decomposition method for analyzing the reliability problems of the system is presented with the help of the renewal process theory. With the decomposition method, two key reliability characteristics of the system i.e. the availability and mean failure number of the system are discussed under some assumptions. It is important that the steady-state availability and steady-state failure frequency of the system are obtained. Furthermore, three special cases of the model have showed that the vacation number taken by the repairman affects the performance of the system and the results presented in this paper are more general than the existing results in some literatures.

articleTitle: Study on application of TPM in small and medium-sized enterprises
abstract: Production facility control system and its current situation in small and medium-sized enterprises were studied in this paper. Equipment management problems were found out through the analysis of equipment management and process of the company studied. This paper focused on the application of TPM in companies, and a new facility management mode that positively propels the improvement of comprehensive efficiency and enterprise vitality was proposed. Practice in many enterprises has been proved that TPM adheres to people-oriented and enhances full participation awareness, which radically changed obsolete equipment management mode and shaped full participation and active atmosphere in enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on evaluation of third-party logistics service quality based on dynamic fuzzy sets
abstract: Researches on third-party logistics have become increasingly fruitful, so it's very urgent to evaluate the service quality of third-party logistics reasonably. This paper establishes a service quality evaluation model of third-party logistics based on the SERVQUAL quality evaluation system, and evaluates the service quality of third-party logistics reasonably with dynamic fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method. The results show that dynamic fuzzy method can accurately reflect where the failure of third party logistics services is, and give forecasts. Finally, the validity of the model is verified by an example.

articleTitle: Anomaly detection for equipment condition via cross-correlation approximate entropy
abstract: In this paper, a new method named cross-correlation approximate entropy is proposed based on the correlation analysis and the approximate entropy theory. It can detect anomaly of running state in a quantitative manner without any priori knowledge. The method takes a section of signal with fixed-length of running state of equipment as a window. By sliding the window through the state signal, the paper calculates the cross-correlation function of the first window and latter ones, and then figure out their approximate entropy values. This paper sets the approximate entropy value of cross-correlation function of the first and second windows as the standard value. If there is an anomaly, the approximate entropy value of cross-correlation function of windows will be far larger than the standard value. Finally, a case is studied to test the validity and stability of this method by using the normal vibration signals of normal and faulty rolling bearing.

articleTitle: A framework of business process outsourcing relationship evolution model
abstract: The benefits of outsourcing are concluded in terms of lowering costs, better operational quality system and bridging of the skills deficiency. All these benefits depend on how well the relationship is forged. The objective of this study is to explore the evolution process of the relationship with the growth of outsourcing vendor and client. Based on literature review, a three-stage evolution model is put forward, namely, the cost stage, resource stage and partnership stage. Each stage has the specific characteristic, thus the partners share the common focus, different with the other stages. The proposed model can help clients and vendors in outsourcing relationships understand both current state and future direction of development in their relationship.

articleTitle: Research on retail enterprise supply chain risk identification based on SCOR
abstract: In order to help the retail enterprises to manage supply chain risk effectively, this paper analyzes the supply chain risk factors starting from risk identification based on SCOR which distinguishes the risk factors from five phases: planning, purchasing, sales, delivery and return. The conclusion is that the risk identification is important and there are a lot of factors which affect the supply chain risk.

articleTitle: Study on operation modes and implementation tactics of patent pool
abstract: To realize enterprises' patent strategy in complex innovation environment, patent pool is an important method. According to whether there exists dominant enterprise in the operation process of patent pool or not, the patent pool operation modes consist of pool platform basis and dominant enterprise basis. Then, analyze and compare the patent licensing mode and fee, patent judgment of joining pool, ways of getting benefit and so on between the two operation modes of patent pool. Finally, the paper proposes the concrete tactics for alliance enterprise using patent pool to gain competitive advantage.

articleTitle: Application of fuzzy cluster analysis in impact factor evaluation of technology innovation
abstract: Many factors affect the technology innovation power. But every factor's impact degree is vague. The traditional cluster analysis method can not reasonably evaluate these factors' impact degree. Based on fuzzy cluster analysis and matlab software, the paper can obtain more reasonable evaluation results about various factors' impact degree on technology innovation power. The evaluation results can give positive guidance for technology innovation decision-making. The research is of great theoretical value and practical significance for grasping main factors which have significant effect on the technology innovation power and improving relevant management measures.

articleTitle: Children road traffic safety education effect evaluation based on multiple-representations
abstract: Because cognitive characteristics and mental characteristics of children are limited, the road traffic safety educational methods should stimulate children's interest and make them focus on the taught content. In order to get the better educational method three different kinds of educational methods are analyzed from effect to short-term memory, long term memory and mental load. Through relative analysis and comparative evaluation, the method of combination of ordinary classroom instruction and playing road traffic safety cartoon is the most effective method from the effect of short-term memory, long-term memory and mental load. Multiple representations approach and multicenter method are better than monotonous educational method for children road traffic safety education.

articleTitle: A business opportunity in the e-era: Apparel network marketing
abstract: E-commerce transactions in the present market play an increasingly large proportion, and apparel consumption in the e-era has great business opportunities, to make in-depth study of apparel network marketing is necessary. Compared to the traditional marketing model, apparel network marketing has an advantage in the operating cost, convenience, interactivity, etc., but there are many deficiencies: Virtual technical problems, after sales inconvenience and user information security weaknesses. Enterprises must make innovation in product development and virtual technology, improve the quality of network services and combine traditional marketing with network marketing, in order to ultimately achieve the desired effect of network marketing. So the enterprise wireless internet technology will provide the opportunity for the business of future.

articleTitle: On the risk analysis for e-commerce based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation
abstract: As the pillar industry of the national economics, e-commerce nowadays has played a great role in the GDP growth and it owns the characters of both high risk and high earning rate. Taking the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation into risks analysis and with the help of the analytical hierarchy process, all the risks arising from e-commerce process were assigned by the proper weights, which aimed at the quantitative and overall evaluation for e-commerce risks. Based on the theory of risks management, a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model was brought forward in this paper and it offered the detail risks managements for e-commerce. Further more, all the conclusions of risks management proposed in this model have passed the empirical discrimination.

articleTitle: Research on location of remanufacturing factory based on particle swarm optimization
abstract: Focus on reverse logistics location of remanufacturing factory, a mixed integer programming model is constructed on the basis of minimum cost. Then particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is introduced in the model. Discrete PSO is used to solve reverse logistics location of remanufacturing factory, and the distribution of goods is solved by traditional PSO algorithm. The optimal solution of the model is obtained by nesting discrete PSO and traditional PSO, which reduces the calculation complexity, selects the reverse logistics remanufacturing factory efficiently, and the network structure of reverse logistics is optimized. The experiment results show that the method is feasible and efficient.

articleTitle: A ship manufacturing model for fractal-based green supply chain
abstract: The paper constructs the ship manufacturing based on the fractal theory and focuses on the green manufacturing target which is compatible with the environment. Firstly, the paper presents three layers operation model of “enterprise layer - business layer - homework layer” which adapts to the green supply chain of ship manufacturing, then analyses the model under the freely double dimension structure decomposition. Therefore, the ship manufacturing can adjust the operational parameters and resource information automatically by modifying the structure and relationship of the model under the changing operational environment, so that the green supply chain of ship manufacturing can reach the aim of adapting with the operational environment, and achieve the final goal to sustain long-term survival and development.

articleTitle: Some arithmetic aggregation operators within intuitionistic trapezoidal fuzzy setting and their application to group decision making
abstract: As intuitionistic trapezoidal fuzzy number can reveal the degree of an attribute satisfy or dissatisfy a trapezoidal fuzzy number rather than a certain fuzzy concept, it is interesting to introduce it to resolve multi-criteria decision making problems. This paper reviews some existed intuitionistic trapezoidal aggregation operators and presents a new arithmetic aggregation operator, i.e. induced intuitionistic trapezoidal fuzzy ordered weighting aggregation operator which includes a general reordering step. Some operational laws about the operator are studied, as well as relationships between it and other existed aggregation operators. Then a multi-criteria group decision making process is developed utilizing the proposed operator and the intuitionistic trapezoidal fuzzy weighting arithmetic average operator, the validity and practicality of which illustrated by a numerical example about the evaluation of security of information systems from related literature.

articleTitle: Research on supply chain management based on RFID technology
abstract: In recent years, Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) gradually becomes essential to improve the logistics supply chain management. This paper describes the characteristics of RFID technology, also analyzes problems of RFID applied in logistics supply chain management, such as the high cost of raw materials, real-time tracking problems, the limited service, low level of logistics management. The application of RFID technology can achieve cost savings, real-time tracking of goods, improve the recognition rate, and improve operating efficiency. On this basis, further study on RFDI development prospects in the logistics field has a certain reality and reference.

articleTitle: Local obstacle avoidance planning of logistics system AGV based vector field
abstract: In the case of knowing the environmental information of static obstacles, in order to improve the path of AGV (automatic guided vehicle) in logistics system, the paper uses a method of path planning which based on modified potential field. The potential field is more convenient and efficient than the intelligent method, and it's one of many path planning methods. The calculated amount of improved algorithm is little, it's easier to meet real-time requirement and relatively simple in mathematical description, resulting in relatively smooth and safe path. Improved potential field improves the operation efficiency and safety of the system in actual system applications. The analysis of the typical examples verifies the validity of this method.

articleTitle: The effects of work-family enrichment on knowledge workers' job burnout and mental health
abstract: With the coming of knowledge-based economy, the work-family relationship of knowledge workers has received increasing concerns. This paper studies knowledge workers in Changzhou and proposes hypotheses on knowledge workers' work-family enrichment, job burnout, and mental health. Based on questionnaire and data analysis, our models are empirically supported. Our conclusions are work-family enrichment has a significantly positive correlation to job burnout and mental health while family-work enrichment has a significantly negative correlation to job burnout and mental health. Based on a data analysis and discussions, we finally propose suggestions from the perspectives of firm, individuals, and family.

articleTitle: Analysis of the predictive indicators of knowledge workers' job burnout: A perspective of organization
abstract: Knowledge workers are the high incidence group of job burnout because of fierce social competition and occupational stress. Aiming at getting the characteristics of knowledge workers, this paper analyzes the main forming reasons of job burnout, explores the prediction indexes of knowledge workers' job burnout based on organizational job design, including the workload, interpersonal support, amount of information, job control, organizational justice and job satisfaction. The analysis and evaluation of prediction indexes with evaluation function help to identify the burnout and intervene in it, so as to reduce the incidence of knowledge workers' job burnout.

articleTitle: From employees' OCB to customers' OCB: Testing a mediation model
abstract: Organizational citizenship behavior to customers (OCB-C) and customer citizenship behavior (CCB) are two new branches in organizational citizenship behavior field. Here, we introduced social identity theory and derived customer identification theory to explore how OCB-C influence CCB through customer identification. A mediation model was put forward, and propositions were established, showing that OCB-C has positive effect on CCB through mediating effects of customer identification. Implications were discussed and the future research agenda was advanced.

articleTitle: Based on kernel function and non-parametric multiple imputation algorithm to solve the problem of missing data
abstract: To fill the data missed and to make statistical activities more effectively response, according to the missing mechanism the data is missing at random (MAR) and missing completely at random (MCAR) conditions, several methods for missing data, multiple imputation, kernel function of non-parametric regression analysis are introduced. The kernel function of non-parametric regression analysis is analyzed with emphasis, and the corresponding functions and the theorem for their analytical methods are discussed. Then, an example is introduced to verify the accuracy of this method. By analyzing, the results show that the data filled according to the methods of kernel function of non-parametric regression analysis can replace the original data, and the statistical results are identified with the original ones.

articleTitle: Game on the quality of logistics outsourcing for fresh food supervision
abstract: The fresh food logistics outsourcing quality supervision is analyzed by using the game theory. Based on different hypothesis models of one-stage game and multi-stage games are established. And the equilibrium strategy for the two parties is produced. Some key factors impact on the two parties. Some factors like the supervision cost of the fresh food enterprises and the cheat amount for the third party company are discussed. Then the paper suggests that fresh food enterprises reduce the risks or the quality problems of the logistics outsourcing.

articleTitle: Research on succession influencing factors in the family business
abstract: The purpose of this study was to better understand the succession of family business in China. The paper made the systemic analysis of the internal and external environment to explain the succession influencing factors in family business. Based on a review and analysis of the literature, the paper presents a model on the factors that influence the family business succession in China.

articleTitle: The influence of customer participation on employee job stress—The empirical research based on the role theory
abstract: In light of the conflicting findings in previous research on the influence of customer participation on employee job stress, it's a very meaningful study to explain the difference. Based on the role theory, two experiments were conducted in the MBA teachers. ANOVA was used to provide evidence that there was significant difference in the degree of employee job stress among the two levels of customer participation. Additionally, two-factor ANOVA revealed that role orientation and perspective taking can all coordinate the relationship between customer participation and employee job stress. So the argument is that enhancing role orientation and perspective taking can relieve employee job stress in customer participation.

articleTitle: Empirical study on evaluation of tourism web sites in China
abstract: In network economy, it's very important for Chinese tourism web sites to raise their core competence. This paper adopts multiple correspondence to evaluate Chinese tourism websites by utilizing real-time detecting tool. In this research, tourism websites should improve their service levels through constructing their web sites and strengthening their service functions.

articleTitle: Comprehensive evaluation of human resource crisis
abstract: In order to grasp the states of human resource management accurately, this paper studies the whole process of human resource management from the input to the output of human resource, establishes the evaluation index system of human resource crisis, and evaluates the human resource management crisis of the enterprise with principal component analysis. This paper draws the following conclusions: the crisis level of human resource can be obtained not only using the longitudinal dates of the enterprise, but also using the multiple competitors' horizontal cross-section dates.

articleTitle: Research of test model of innovative enterprise development's inner power based on BP neural network
abstract: In order to testify the inner power of enterprise development, BP network Model is adopted and relevant data is selected (including input and output data) as experiment samples. After inputting sample data, the system studies the data automatically. When the error is reduced to the required extent, the system stops studying. The BP neural network study calculation is processed by Matlab software in order to practice the neutral network model of enterprise development's inner power, and it is the main index of testing and evaluating enterprise development's inner power, so as to improve and adjust the relevant factors of an enterprise development's inner power.

articleTitle: Application of BCC algorithm in optimization of plate finned-tube heat exchanger
abstract: Plate finned-tube heat exchanger (PFTHX) is a kind of simple and frequently used heat exchanger in industry. A bacterial colony chemotaxis (BCC) optimization algorithm is applied to the optimization of geometry parameters such as the fin number, tube row number, tube column number, etc. of a PFTHX, and the optimization objective is the total manufacture cost or the thermodynamics performance indices. The BCC optimization algorithm is derivatively-free, and the convergence speed is fast, especially, it is irrelevant to the kind of the heat exchanger. A simple verification case was conducted and the result is acceptable.

articleTitle: User activity-based CF algorithm in value-added services
abstract: In order to overcome problems of scoring subjectively, this paper applies CF to recommendation systems of Mobile value-added service, presents the scoring way in value-added service, transfer the users' behavior to the extent of agreement. Meanwhile, using user contact degree to calculate the product rate which users don't give rate in the real world, so as to solve the sparsity problem of CF. At last, experiment is adopted to prove that the method of using service activity with contact degree is better than traditional method in the field of recall frequency and precision.

articleTitle: Evaluation report on innovative power of Heilongjiang medical industrial cluster
abstract: The development of pharmaceutical industry of Heilongjiang reflects growing features of industrial cluster. From a perspective of innovation theory, industrial industry is an innovative network, whose innovative power affects the competitiveness of the whole industry of the cluster and the prospect of the development. Based on examination of constituents of innovative power of Heilongjiang pharmaceutical industry cluster, the paper establishes a model of evaluation system of its competitiveness, brings forth an objective result through a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation, puts forward some proposals for the promotion of innovative power of Heilongjiang pharmaceutical industry cluster.

articleTitle: Self-reconfiguration planning of self-reconfigurable robot based on Windmill-like crystal cell group
abstract: Motion and self-reconfiguration are basic abilities of modular self-reconfigurable robot (MSR), most MSRs' unit modules do not have these abilities. Therefore, Windmill-like crystal cell group (WLCCG) is designed and have the abilities of moving, self-reconfiguring, changing azimuth of the other modules and carrying other modules. The motion is similar to the molecular motion. Thus the reconfiguration processes from initial configuration which are constructed by 24 modules to “H” configuration can be realized. In the process of planning the sequence of module connecting, disconnecting and rotating, the paper found that the robot configuration made of four WLCCGs can realize reconfigurable moving function. The algorithm based on the gradient of the potential field is used in planning the moving path of robot composed of WLCCGs. The actions of robot are realized by fixed motion sequence database.

articleTitle: Study on earnings management of enterprise — Based on game theory
abstract: Earnings management is studied to control accounting information for profit of enterprise in the scope of accounting principle. In the paper, the earnings management of enterprise is analyzed in view of the game theory and based on many sides' game action including the board,managers and investors. Moreover, conclusion is drawn that the managers could choose whether they can carry out earnings management or not according to enterprise's own business circumstances and self-interest maximization, and managers should try to reduce earnings management, focus on increasing revenue and product added value, cost control, and create more profits in essence instead of optimizing profit.

articleTitle: New product development and technical innovation of China's trade
abstract: This paper introduces the new product development and technical innovation of China's trade. The paper expounds viewpoint from brand concept, ethnic culture and so on, which points out that green design, high technology content and rules of trade are the methods and strategies to develop international market. The paper concludes that developing new products and using technical innovation are the ways to change economic growth and to build the innovative country of china.

articleTitle: Cluster analysis of the consumption value based on the clothing market
abstract: This study explored the consuming value of customers from urban area based on the analysis of Beijing clothing market. Six consumer value factors were found through the clothing buying process: group interaction value factor, practical function value factor, aesthetic taste value factor, economy value factor, seeking fashion and novelty value factor, and status and achievement value factor. This study adopted Cluster analysis, variance analysis and chi-square analysis, and issued the relevant explanations from the view of consumer value management based on the analysis results. This study offers the basic information for the future theoretical research and marketing practices.

articleTitle: Analysis of risk in EPC project and the countermeasures
abstract: This paper analyzes the characteristics of EPC project, the owner is only responsible for the whole and principled management and control of the goal; the contractor undertakes most risks; the owner only signs a project general contract with EPC general contractor, which adopts the lump sum contract; and the transaction cost of EPC mode is lower etc. Based on the analysis above, this paper explains that risk management is more important for EPC project. Then through the contrasting approaches and positivist methods, this paper comes to a conclusion: in the engineering construction of EPC project, owner and the general contractor should get a clear understanding of the situation and make a reply rationally. And at last the paper proposes some countermeasures to the specific risks.

articleTitle: Order acceptance strategy with lead-time flexibility in BTO environment
abstract: In order to make the largest profits for manufacturers in build-to-order (BTO) supply chain environment, order acceptance decision models are presented. Manufacturer with finite production capacity has ability to select lead-time flexibility in BTO supply chain environment. Two order processing method, i.e., split-lot processing and whole-lot processing, are considered. How the different lead-time flexibility and various manufacturing environment influence profits and the choice of order acceptance is analyzed through a numeric example. Numerical analyzes show that whatever the environment is, profits gained from split-lot order processing is always higher than from whole-lot order processing. The conclusion can provide manager with useful guidance during order acceptance selection.

articleTitle: Research on recycling economy oriented product disassembly sequence planning approach
abstract: Under the background of recycling economy strategy, rising environmental costs become serious hazards for the industrial enterprise. To avoid these hazards special activities have to be adopted during the product design phase. Disassembly plays a key role in recycling of materials and components for protecting our environment. In this paper, to realize automated and intelligence of product disassembly sequence planning, a feasibility graph is utilized to represent the abstracted product disassembly sequence mathematical model. Then an improved max-min ant system based on the strategy of sorting elite ants was proposed to find optimal disassembly sequence for given product. Finally, the simulation test for proposed algorithm and a prototype system that supports product disassembly design is developed.

articleTitle: Analysis of accounting disclosure quality in capital markets: Current situation and impact factors
abstract: The primary objective of this paper is to analyze the significant impact factors of accounting disclosure quality in capital markets and try to ascertain what lessons can be learned from the past for future developments. This paper first reviewed related existing literature about accounting disclosure quality. Second, some financial fraud and corporate collapses illustrated the mismatch between current situation and expectation. Structural impacts factors system were built in particular while having spread out six impact factors including external auditing, adoption of International Financial Reporting Standards, legal regulation, internal governance, voluntary disclosure and share price. Finally, conclusion is that adoption of International Financial Reporting Standards and voluntary disclosure are more significant impact factors than others. Furthermore, considering adoption of Sarbanes-Oxley Act will certainly influence accounting disclosure quality.

articleTitle: Simulation model for quantifying the environmental impact and demand amplification of a Product-Service System (PSS)
abstract: The concept of a Product-Service System (PSS) was firstly published in 1999 as a `product(s) and service(s) combined in a system to deliver required user functionality in a way that reduces the impact on the environment'. Although this concept has been discussed in literatures over a decade, it still lacks of tools for evaluating the impacts of a PSS in a supply chain. This paper proposes a simple model based on a system dynamics simulation for quantifying the environmental impact and demand amplification along a supply chain when a PSS is applied. The proposed model is comprised of four generic models which are an Inventory model, a Linkage model, a Contribution model and a PSS model. A simple case of a PSS in a washing machine business was selected to validate and demonstrate the flexibility of the proposed model. The results showed that a PSS was able to decrease demand amplification by smoothing the end customer demand in a supply chain. Moreover, a PSS was capable to reduce the total number of washing machines to fulfill customer need while it was able to increase an opportunity to replace those machines with new items which were adapted technology to reduce water and energy consumptions. Consequently the total amount of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission generated in a PSS was lower than in a traditional purchase system. Therefore, a PSS has potential to reduce the environmental impact and demand amplification in a supply chain.

articleTitle: Research about product innovation of SME based on market orientation
abstract: Many important sources of production innovation came from customers and suppliers. Marketing planning in SMEs is constrained by limited time and money, limited expertise, this paper introduced the context of innovation and product innovation, discussed the advantage of small and middle enterprise(SME) to develop their product innovation, researched the relation between market orientation and product innovation, analyzed marketing channels and market orientation how to influence on product innovation. The paper considered the conduct innovation vary of SMEs across industries depending on entry costs and market niches, through acquisition of external knowledge for innovation so as to avoid disadvantage of only users of technology.

articleTitle: Empirical research on hedging strategy of Chinese index future market
abstract: This paper examines hedging strategy in Chinese stock index futures market. Focus on task of forming a portfolio which holds long position of limited numbers of stock that outperforms the underlying index, and meanwhile holds short position of related index future. In order to select proper stocks, the particle swarm optimization is implemented, with minimizing the downside risk of return. The empirical study, hedging IF1012 on Hushen 300 index, reveals that based on this strategy, the portfolio could achieve relatively positive return.

articleTitle: Research on VIP customer classification rule base on RFM model
abstract: With the development of society and increasingly fierce competition in the retail industry, seeking and maintaining VIP customers are the focus of competition between supermarkets. The purpose of this study is to dig out the most important VIP customers from all customers, using data mining based on rough set technology. An RFM model is used in classification of VIP customers, which achieves the simplification and extraction of rules. As a result, a new way is provided that managers can quickly determine the customer level.

articleTitle: Study on logistics operation cost control based on the DEA model
abstract: To solve the problem that the logistics operation cost can't be controlled well by traditional methods, a DEA (data envelopment analysis) model is presented. The mechanism of the model is to make the logistics activities as a decision making unit to evaluate the efficiency of input and output. Base on the DEA result, the efficient logistics activities are reserved, and the inefficient ones are improved by explicit methods and goals. The key procedures of DEA model include establishing a standard logistics activity database, decomposing logistics activities and determining that the logistics is the efficient decision unit. The paper is of great significance to improve operation efficiency of logistics network.

articleTitle: An analysis on competition game between oligopoly suppliers and vertical integration manufacturers
abstract: Vertical integration refers to one of the options that firms make decisions in the supply of oligopoly market. It was impacted by competition game between upstream firms and downstream firms. Based on the game theory and other previous studies,this paper built a dynamic game model of two-stage competition between the oligopoly suppliers of upstream and the vertical integration firms of downstream manufacturers. In the first stage, it analyzed the influences on integration degree by prices of intermediate goods when an oligopoly firm engages in a Bertrand-game if outputs are not limited. Moreover, it analyzed the influences on integration degree by price-diverge of intermediate goods if outputs were not restricted within a Bertrand Duopoly game equilibrium. In the second stage, there is a Cournot duopoly game between downstream specialization firms and downstream integration firms. Their marginal costs are affected by the integration degree and their yields are affected either under indifferent manufacture conditions. Finally, prices of intermediate goods are determined by the competition of upstream firms, the prices of intermediate goods affect the changes of integration degree between upstream firms and downstream firms. The conclusions can be referenced to decision-making of integration in market competition.

articleTitle: Isomorphic relationship between regional culture and organizational culture: A case study of Daqing Oilfield Limited Company
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to explore the Isomorphic relationship between regional and organizational culture by a case study combined with qualitative and quantitative research methods in Daqing Oilfield Limited Company. The result shows that the organizational culture of the company is dominated by the Hierarchy and Clan culture, and is full of harmonious and concordant, the sense of collectivism and teamwork. The organizational culture of the Company is compatible and isomorphic with its regional culture, which is marked with the Daqing spirit. And how the relationship might be is analyzed and discussed.

articleTitle: Study on the factors influencing Chinese IPO pricing
abstract: This paper studies each factor which influences IPO pricing in order to make IPO pricing closer to markets, more objective and more reasonable. By analyzing all kinds of factors influencing IPO pricing and applying the multiple linear regression prediction, this paper establishes a rational pricing model of IPO on the stage. With the multiple factor regression equation, this model can quantize the influence on share prices brought by each factor. Finally, by using data analysis method associated with the particular case of China stock markets, the validity of the established model is verified.

articleTitle: Research on situation assessment of urban passenger hub based on AHP and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation
abstract: By analyzing the content of situation assessment of urban passenger hub, adhering to the principles of objective, practical and scientific, the reasonable evaluation index system was formed. And on this basis, urban passenger transport hub was comprehensively evaluated using AHP and the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method. Finally in this paper a certain urban passenger transport hub was considered as a case, and the process of application of this method was introduced. Through the case studies, it proves that this method is simple, effective and operable, and the results of evaluation are fair and objective, reasonable and easy.

articleTitle: Discrete GM(1,1) model and its application for forecasting of real estate prices
abstract: This paper makes a systematic study and analysis about the improving form Discrete GM(1,1) Model of grey forecasting model GM(1,1),and the model's effectiveness and reliance are illustrated with the living example of forecasting of real estate prices. Research results show that DGM(1,1) model can be considered as the precise form of grey forecasting model. Providing a kind of new method for forecasting prices of real estate market, the paper has important guiding significance for rational development of real estate industry.

articleTitle: Study on the performance management system of service-oriented manufacturing enterprises
abstract: In view of the manufacturing enterprises' servitization, the performance of the management system is established by combining Balanced Scorecard, Service Profit Chain and System Dynamics, which is suitable for service-oriented manufacturing enterprises. Take S enterprise for example, the strategy map, the causal relationship and the graph of system dynamic flow are built. On this basis, the enterprise's internal and external changes are simulated to observe the changes of key performance indicators by computer, and then compare the results arising from different policies through the study of the policy simulation, finally make a strategic choice.

articleTitle: Neural adaptive attitude tracking controller for flexible spacecraft
abstract: This article presents a neural network adaptive controller for attitude tracking of flexible spacecraft in situations when there exist inertial matrix and external disturbance. In this approach, neural network technique is employed to approximate the unknown system dynamics with finite combinations of some basis functions, and a robust controller is also designed to attenuating the effect of approximation error, more specially, the knowledge of angular velocity is not required. In the closed-loop system, Lyapunov stability analysis shows that the angular velocity trajectories asymptotically follow the reference output trajectories. Finally, simulation results are presented for the attitude tracking of a flexible spacecraft to show the excellent performance of the proposed controller and illustrate its robustness in face of external disturbances and unknown dynamics.

articleTitle: Research on green supply chain motivation of steel enterprises in China
abstract: In order to ensure the green supply chain management of the steel enterprise in china implemented effectively, a motivation contract was put forward to encourage the members of the supply chain to implement “green” reformation actively. The model based on principal-agent theory and contract theory was built to distinguish members who has really reformed, and analyze the effect of the contract on supply chain members' expectation profits and efficiency. Results show that the motivation contract can not only distinguish the true “green” reformer, but also can inspires supply chain members to carry out “green” reform effectively. The steel enterprise in china can construct green supply chain system with this model.

articleTitle: Research on countermeasures to develop a low carbon economy in Dalian
abstract: As one of the most important port city in north China, Dalian is planning to construct the ecological livable city. To resolve the problems of high carbon contained and low resource efficiency for the city's economic structure, the municipal government must find right ways to transform to the low carbon economy. With Linear Regressive Model to forecast the city's energy resources efficiency, the municipal government who wants to make high-effective and low carbon economy policies must consider two radical pathways. One is increasing energy efficiency that indicated by energy consumption rate. The second is to find the reproductive energy to substitute the fossil energy. All the material policies applied by the government derive from the two ways.

articleTitle: The estimation of default probabilities with liquidity by Markov chain
abstract: The effection of liquidity on the financial risk is becoming more and more important. Ignoring it the risk analysis would be in failure. This paper provides a default-risky debt valuation model, which assumes that market liquidity modelled by the intensity of default is driven by a continuous-time Markov chain. The model accounts for default probability with liquidity risk calibrated. A semimartingale representation of a liquid defaultable debt price is obtained. The illiquidity is modelled as exogenously specified stochastic reduction in the price of the debt, which adds more risks for the investors.

articleTitle: Study on the relationship between resources recycling and reduction as well as being harmless: A case of forest industrial enterprises
abstract: To promote the reduction of resources use and harmless production, the paper analyzes the relationship between resource recycling and reduction or harmlessness. Based on the mode of resource recycling in forest industrial enterprises, this paper builds flowcharts of waste resource recycling. Circular economy development of forestry can be promoted, if the forest industrial enterprises can make the natural resources recycle in their internal producing process.

articleTitle: Synthetic evaluation on listed companies in ceramic industry based on a combined weight method
abstract: The number of listed companies in the ceramic industry in China stock market is very small, but represents the development situation of the whole industry. Evaluation on the performance efficiency of the listed companies is very important. Traditional AHP and DEA evaluation methods face problems of subjectivity or lack of human factors. A combination method which integrates advantages of the two models can be used to evaluate status and efficiency of the listed companies in the ceramic industry. Input and output indicators are carefully selected. Data of input and output indicators are carefully ascertained and processed on basis of sourcing relative publicized financial report. Finally a ranking list of the seven companies is given.

articleTitle: A comparative analysis of job scheduling algorithm
abstract: For complexity, randomness and dynamic characteristics, job scheduling problem is well known as NP-hard, and a lot of research about scheduling algorithms was conducted in the past. In this paper, the definition and classification of job scheduling problem are firstly given, and then a systematic and complete comparative analysis of job scheduling algorithms is carried out from the aspects of origin, characteristics, computation and application. Finally, some development trends and characteristics of job scheduling algorithms are proposed.

articleTitle: A new F-GERT network model in consideration of the fuzzy information
abstract: Graphical evaluation review technique is a kind of powerful modeling tools whose scope of application covers almost all areas of the national economy. But classical GERT network technology can't solve random network with the fuzzy information parameter. In view of random network with the fuzzy information parameter, a new F-GERT network modeling technique which considers the fuzzy information is proposed in this paper. Moreover, the moments and moment generating function of F-GERT network are constructed and the important mathematical nature of four aspects is discussed in detail. On this basis, the simulation algorithm of F-GERT network is studied using signal flow graph principle. Through simulating the paper concludes that the model of F-GERT network and simulation algorithm which are proposed in this paper can solve the social economy question effectively and the effect is good.

articleTitle: The ship monitoring and control network system design
abstract: The world trend is that the monitoring, intelligent control and systematic management to the instruments and equipments are integrated both on bridge and in engine room in ship automation. The design scheme of the ship integrated monitoring and operating system based on two layers distributed and redundant computer network was presented in this paper. The distributed schemes are fully applied to both software and hardware. The composition, software distribution and redundant technology in the upper local network were described, some important sample codes was given to prove the design and can be realized. The technologies here can be applied in the other industrial fields.

articleTitle: A Logistics model in natural disaster
abstract: An emergency logistics model based on Location-routing Problem (LRP) is proposed in this paper, and a two-phase heuristic algorithm is used to solve the model. It uses the minimization envelopment analysis method to solve the LRP in the emergency supplies center, and then calculates K shorter paths by the application of the nearest neighbor method. Considering the indexes of time, security, economic cost and environment cost of emergency transportation routing, the paper establishes a shortest-path with the method of Analytic Network Process (ANP). Based on the analysis and calculation of an example, the results indicate that the model and method are effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Automated negotiation model of supply chain management based on multi-agent
abstract: Coordination problem is the key issues of supply chain management; Coordination not only can solve the integration problem in the process of modern enterprises in E-business information system effectively, but also improve the agility, dynamic and flexibility of supply chain. Coordination and collaboration between agents are the main ways to complete various tasks of supply chain. In order to promote coordination between supply chains, this paper builds up the autonomic negotiation models on Ontology, on negotiation and bid, on software based on M-agent.

articleTitle: Research on relationship between competitive priorities and business performance based on modular customization
abstract: In order to adapt to new competitive environment, enterprises will adopt modular customization of production patterns. Through analysis of the modular customization theory and the competitive priorities theory, this paper proposes the theoretical hypothesis of the relationship between competitive priorities and business performance in the modular customization. On the basis of International Manufacturing Strategy Survey (IMSS) database, competitive priorities are divided into five elements of innovation, quality, flexibility, delivery and cost in modular customization by using factor analysis, then based on the results, the paper establishes Structural Equation Model (SEM) to research relationship between the competitive priorities and the business performance in the modular customization. The results indicate that there is positive correlation between competitive priorities and business performance in modular customization, but they are different in the degree of influence.

articleTitle: Resilient supply chain system coordinating: Mechanism designing for emergence produced
abstract: To equilibrate the profit distribution mechanism that is invalided by emergency in supply chain, a game model is constructed to distribute profits among enterprises in supply chain, and the optimal strategies for every enterprise can be got after resolving this model, to fit for emergency. Considering the strategies' distinction between from system decision and from decentralization decision, then, a coordination mechanism is designed to smooth the conflict between supplier and retailer down. The result explains the economic phenomena that why increasing the size of market makes the wholesale price increased (similarly the opposite), but the production plan do not change regularly.

articleTitle: Empirical research about the influence of analysts following behavior on stock price informativeness
abstract: By using Chinese listed companies as the research sample, the paper adopted stock price non-synchronicity method to measure stock price informativeness and then took an empirical test about the influence of securities analysts following behavior on stock price informativeness based on panel data regression models. The empirical results indicate that: the following behavior of Chinese securities analysts is notably positively correlated to stock price informativeness. Namely it's that Chinese securities analysts can use its information-gathering means and expert analysis capabilities to announce valuable profit forecast information, which would prompt more firm-specific information into stock prices.

articleTitle: Analyses of the captured incidents and its security strategy in government portal websites
abstract: Captured incidents do not only damage the image of the government but also undermine the public trust. The paper analyzes objectively the main captured incident and its reasons what happened. Then the corresponding strategy through personal, technology and management is discussed how to strengthen safeguard in website to provide more guaranty for use and development. The security strategies help to improve ruling ability and service level of government, also play an important role in constructing service government.

articleTitle: Applying portfolio theory to the valuation of forest biodiversity
abstract: Research on the similarity between securities portfolio diversity and forest biodiversity and the return-risk problem of forest biodiversity is preliminarily recognized. This article first comments on Markowitz's portfolio theory, then analyzes the feasibility to introduce this theory to value measurement of forest biodiversity assets, and explores how to make use of this theory to price forest biodiversity, which is to provide a new thought to measure the value of forest biodiversity assets.

articleTitle: A human-centered Virtual Factory
abstract: As the key of manufacturing systems, human factor becomes more and more important in design, planning and decision making stages. In this paper state-of-the-art Virtual Factory (VF) are described regarding the human oriented point of view. To address the two major research questions, this paper proposes a novel human-centered VF concept. Then, according to this concept, the experimental design is introduced and an implementation example of sound simulation is shown in a rebuilt factory model. In addition, to facilitate the planning process in manufacturing system, the simulation results are implemented in Virtual Reality (VR). To do this, a Cave Automatic Virtual Environment (CAVE) is used as experimental platform.

articleTitle: Study on airlines' customer satisfaction based on structural equation model
abstract: In order to evaluate airlines' customer satisfaction properly, the fundamental of structural equation model (SEM) was introduced, the airline's customer satisfaction evaluation model was developed according to airline's operation characteristic, and Air China was taken as an example to validate the theoretic model. SEM given in this paper was proven to be suitable for comprehensively evaluating the rationality of the customer satisfaction index and making a system analysis. The application of SEM in airlines' customer satisfaction evaluation can be an impressive improvement to the traditional method.

articleTitle: An empirical analysis on Chinese inter-bank offered rate based on the VEC model
abstract: We studied empirically the relations among the CHIBOR, CPI, and PPI with a vector error correction model which is available through various kinds of statistics tests. There is at least a cointegration relation among CHIBOR, CPI, and PPI. Negative rate periods of actual CHIBOR are much more than positive rate periods' based on the cointegrating equation curve. Although the CPI and PPI affect the CHIBOR, the CPI effect is much bigger than the PPI's. The VEC model is able to forecast and analyze changes of the CHIBOR.

articleTitle: The game analysis about supervision to the reverse logistics channels members
abstract: The main purpose of this research is to find whether and when manufacturers should implement the supervision to the reverse logistics channels members. Firstly the importance of the supervision to the channel members was illustrated by the game analysis. Then, the paper analyzed the right time and conditions that the supervision should be implemented by building the game model. As a conclusion, the monitoring points of implementation supervision to channel members can be gotten. The manufacturer should monitor them when the channel members are inactive.

articleTitle: Genetic algorithm study and application in the geothermal heating engineering optimization
abstract: To maximize the economic benefits of the geothermal heating system, this paper analyzed the characteristics of geothermal heating system and summarized the main variables that affect the economy of the geothermal heating system. This study established a mathematical model of the geothermal heating system by calculating the annual cost of geothermal heating engineering. The mathematical model was then optimized using genetic algorithm. The conclusion drawn from the case study is that higher economic efficiency can be achieved by the application of genetic algorithm in the geothermal heating system optimization.

articleTitle: Study on interactive multiple attribute negotiation mechanism for large-scale construction based on flexibility theory
abstract: The aim of this paper is to investigate the conflict resolution in a large-scale construction projects using multi-attribute decision-making theory and to aggregate group's preference information. Multi-attribute decision analysis theory and flexible theory are integrated with bargaining theory to coordinate controversial issues among stakeholders in construction project when computer-based automated negotiation fails or is terminated by decision-makers in this paper. Therefore, the paper establishes an interactive multi-attribute bargaining decision model for large-scale construction projects. The interactive decision model can make the controversial issue reached an agreement acceptable to all participants by applying concessions in different objectives. Moreover, the final results are inline with the necessary requirement of group decision-making, i.e., maximizing the preference consistency of participants and minimizing the utility gaps between each negotiator's preference and the group's.

articleTitle: Improving strategies for Heilongjiang provincial culture industry and international culture trade
abstract: To improve the performance of Heilongjiang province cultural industry and cultural trade, and to provide the profound the theoretical and practical supporting for Heilongjiang's construction, the comparative analysis method and quantitative analysis method are introduced to analyze this case, so, the corresponding strategies, from three aspects about government, company, and product, respectively, are gotten. It is proved that these strategies are feasible, which can bring huge innovation for Heilongjiang's culture industry and culture trade.

articleTitle: Executive Information Systems development lifecycle
abstract: EIS (Executive Information Systems) is mainly aimed to provide real time representative information to the high-level management. Based on each executive's information needs, EIS can access both historical and real-time data through ad-hoc queries. This paper presents the concept and the architecture of EIS and also the criteria for evaluating Executive Information Systems. Finally, the advantages of EIS are put forward.

articleTitle: An empirical study on the relationship between industrial development and environmental pollution of Jiangsu province, China
abstract: Gray correlation analysis and improved IPAT model were used to analyzed industrial environmental impact in Jiangsu, china from 1999 to 2009. Empirical results are : a) all the main industrial pollutants have been controlled, especially the industrial solid wastes, except the total volume of industrial waste gas discharged; b) in spite of the eco-efficiency of industrial waste water grows faster than the economy, it has a strong gray correlation with the industrial development and keep growing in the teen years. The emission of the total industrial waste gas and waste water being controlled more strictly was recommended.

articleTitle: A new approach for multi-attribute decision making problem with incomplete information based on Dempster-Shafer theory
abstract: In this paper, for the multi-attribute decision making problems with incomplete information, a new approach is proposed based on the Dempster-Shafer theory, which has simple decision rule and could solve a problem directly based on its incomplete decision matrix. First identify all possible focal elements from the incomplete decision matrix, and then calculate the basic probability assignment of each focal element and the belief function of each decision alternative. Preference relations among the alternatives are determined by their belief functions. A numerical example is given to illustrate the detailed implementation process of the new approach.

articleTitle: Application of improved Fisher Linear Discriminant Analysis approaches
abstract: The objective of discriminant analysis is to use information from the independent variables to achieve the clearest possible separation or discrimination between or among groups, the main task of the present work is to modify the objective functions and make the separation as large as possible. Fisher Linear Discriminant Analysis approach is modified to meet the requirement that maximizes the objective function, some computer simulations show that the modified ones can achieve the same results as the previous one.

articleTitle: Research of automobile production logistics based on network planning technology
abstract: With the rapid development of Chinese automobile market, the competitions of all kinds of enterprises are impetuosity. The efficiency and cost of automobile enterprises become more important than ever. The effects of production logistics to efficiency and cost of production are certificated by automobile industry. Through the quantitative and qualitative analysis, this paper discusses the improvement of the production logistics based on network planning technology. The efficiency of transportation and loading can be increased and the time spent for production can be decreased. The competitive power of automobile enterprise can be improved by the result of this paper.

articleTitle: On valuation methods choice based on analytical hierarchy process—A case of intellectual property valuation
abstract: The technology-based intellectual property valuation practice always meets the dilemma that same valuation object adopted a different valuation method by the different valuation organization would get a very different analyzing result. How to ensure the rationality of the valuation method is still the key point of the process and not yet fully solved out. Based on analytical hierarchy process, this paper brings forward a valuation methods choice model of technology-based intellectual property, which solved out the choice and suitability of different valuation methods such as the income method, the cost method and the market method in different valuation environment. Taking a case of technology-based intellectual property valuation into the model, the result shows that the income method is better than the other two and the last one is the cost method.

articleTitle: Research on assessment system for chemical logistics service providers based on analytic hierarchy process in China
abstract: With the application of the core competence analysis and supply chain theory in process industries, more and more chemical enterprises are outsourcing their non-core business such as logistics business section. However, the challenge is how to choose appropriate logistics suppliers, majority of them tend to focus on cost negotiation which is not suitable right now. This paper analyzes the state of art of the domestic logistics market and constructs rating criteria for logistics suppliers of chemical industry and applies the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) to determine the parameters of the rating system. It's helpful for the chemical enterprise to quantitatively choose their logistics suppliers.

articleTitle: How standards collaboration strategy affects consumer perceived value of product: An empirical research
abstract: This paper investigates the impacts of different standards collaboration strategies on consumer perceived product value. In the research, empirical methods were employed to examine the conceptual model proposed. The results suggest that standards collaboration influences consumer perceived value not only directly but also indirectly through perceived quality and risk as the intermediate variables. The research further reveals that marketing collaboration has more positive effects on perceived value than R&D collaboration. The cooperation between standard initiators and members in value-chain improves consumer perceived value while cooperating with competitors has no significant impact on perceived value. Equity joint ventures, instead of contract-based alliances, can promote the consumers' confidence in the products, which eventually increases consumer perceived value.

articleTitle: Research on the relationship between the regional logistics and economic development based on the model VAR
abstract: Based on the study of relative documents, cargo turnover miles, logistics network density and GDP were used as studying objects, the dynamic econometrics' methods were used, the relationship between the logistics and economic development was analyzed in Jilin province from 1991 to 2007. The result shows that there exists single Granger causality between logistics network density and economic development, and so does the economic development and logistics cargo turnover miles. The conclusion is that there exists positive lagged effects among the Jilin logistics cargo turnover miles, logistics network density and economic development, the logistics network density has clear influence on GDP, however the cargo turnover miles has weak influence on GDP.

articleTitle: Research on green mining logistics system model of coalmine
abstract: Under the guide of green mining theory of coal resource and green logistics concept, green logistics is introduced into the green mining technology. Firstly this paper defines the concept and connotation of green mining logistics based on analysis of green mining technology and green logistics. Then gives the composition of green mining logistics according to coal flow and material flow underground the definition, and puts forward the green mining logistics system model, including green mining techniques system, green mining technique system, green safety management system and green ecological restoration system. Finally analyze relationship among the composition systems of green mining logistics system model.

articleTitle: “Three-Edge” structural model of enterprise sustainable competitive advantage—A new view based on environment
abstract: This paper gives the definition of sustainable competitive advantage (SCA), also outlines the helix evolvement. Different industry has different special environment. At different development stage of the same industry, the difference is obvious. Based on different marketing environment, “three-edge” structural model is constructed in this paper. Three types of environment (Stable environment, dynamic environment, super-compete environment) are involved in the model. In addition, as to SCA, industry advantage is precondition, extension resource is foundation, core competence is the key, strategic capability is impetus, and flexible capability is the base for long. Finally mutual relation among three levels is explained in detail.

articleTitle: An empirical heterogeneous trading strategy model in the Shanghai stock market of China
abstract: In this paper, we study an order-driven stock market where agents have heterogeneous estimates of the fundamental value of the risky asset. The agents are budget-constrained. Their value-based trading strategy in which buys or sells depend on whether the price of the asset is below or above its risk-adjusted fundamental value. We assume that investors' optimal demand for the risky asset depends on wealth, as a result of CRRA utility. We adopt PE and turnover to study fundamentalism and characteristics on cross-sectional earnings impact. The empirical results show that: fundamentalist trading strategy and chartist trading strategy for different combinations have different effects. In China, fat tails and a leptokurtic shape of the return distribution is the fundamentalist trading strategy and chartist trading strategy of the common effects.

articleTitle: Self-similar of fractal in cluster supply chain
abstract: Cluster supply chain is more and more important with the emergence of industrial agglomeration. The self-similar characteristics of fractal theory are investigated based on cluster supply chain. Every fractal unit brings into play cluster effects by self-similar characteristic. A model was constructed to analyze the fractal dimensions size. The model can judge the reasonableness of the cluster supply chain to provide an effective basis for supply chain management.

articleTitle: A brief analysis on the sustainable development system of architectural ceramics industry and the causality
abstract: How to achieve the sustainable development of the architectural ceramics industry has become an urgent problem pressing for solution. This paper analyzes the industrial system of the architectural ceramics industry (ACI) in a sustainable manner, and puts forward a system framework of “characteristics constructional architectural ceramics industrye-conomy - resources and environment”. Based on the causal relationship between them, the paper makes sure that the basic goal of the sustainable development of ACI is to set up a mechanism, which can satisfy the coordinated development of socio-economy and ACI with the consideration of the carrying capacity of resources and environment. Also the paper indicates several key points on the choice of its sustainable development model and promoting measures.

articleTitle: A study on enterprise financial BPR based on the value chain theory
abstract: The value chain theory is a powerful tool for the enterprise financial BPR. By eliminating non-value-added chain, the enterprise can realize the maximum value of financial processes, in order to achieve the goal of maximizing the value of enterprise. Using the value chain theory and the modern information technology, this paper analyzes the existing financial processes, sets up the financial BPR frame model. Among them, the design idea of vouchers of converting module is elaborated and evaluation indicators are proposed.

articleTitle: The economic growth effect of the North-east regional industry investment
abstract: The industry investment emphasizes how the role of the investment may effect the structure of the industry and whether the investment could stimulate the industry for further development. Taking the regional productivity and relative advantage into consideration and using Polynomial distributed lags model, the dynamic correlation between gross fixed assets investment and GDP of the three industries in the North-East region of China was analyzed. The study shows that the investment for the three industries obviously effects demand stimulation in the short term. The industry investment's contribution to the three industries continues in a long period. The third industry is affected more than the other two and the last one is the first industry.

articleTitle: The research of fuzzy cluster analysis of agent construction project based on Rough set
abstract: Since its application in the government-invested projects in China, the agent construction system has made remarkable achievements. However, the relative risk research in this area is still relatively backward. According to the characteristics of agent construction project, the risk factors and appropriate consequences are summarized, and the concept of the combination weights is put forward. Based on the Rough set theory, the risk combination weighs are calculated. Finally the transitive closure method is applied to make the fuzzy cluster analysis against the risk factor combination. This paper sets up a simple and objective method for the risk management of the agent construction project, and the example verifies the feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Research on pricing policy of three competitors with service level based on Hotelling model
abstract: In order to achieve competitive advantage, many enterprises usually adjust prices to obtain more customers and maximize their profits. Thus, pricing policy is of vital and associated with many factors. Based on Hotelling model, the optimal prices of multi-competitors are deduced with respect to maximum profit. The paper takes three competitors for example and compares the optimal prices with different constrained conditions. Theory studies indicate that if service levels of three competitors are the same, the optimal price located in the middle is lower, if not, the optimal prices related to locations and service levels are difficultly compared.

articleTitle: A study on social demand structure of top talents' ability and quality
abstract: To resolve the contradiction between job seekers and recruiters, on the basis of literature research and survey of social employers, this paper obtained important evaluation data about ability and quality factors of top talents from employers. With factor analysis method, this paper abstracted 5 principal components containing 21 items, which constitute the social demand structure of top talents' ability and quality. These 5 principal components were named Mentality character qualities, Creativity qualities, Professional qualities, Leadership qualities and Interview qualities respectively.

articleTitle: High-tech product market forecasting based on grey-Markov model
abstract: The sale of the high-tech product is the main symbol for the successful transformation of scientific and technological achievements. Since the sale is influenced by all kinds of indefinite interior and external factors. The sale is of random uncertainty and information incompleteness. Based on grey-Markov forecasting model this paper forecasts the sale of the product and demonstrates its availability by an empirical study. The coupled model has higher forecasting accuracy and applicative value, so that the paper provides scientific and feasible quantum foundation for forecasting high-tech product market.
