articleTitle: Design and implementation of enterprise financing decision model based on data mining
abstract: Based on the data warehouse, data mining techniques, using the method of system, The paper analyzed the use of data mining strategy in enterprise financing decisions, Studied the financing decision system design goal, the function and the logic structure model, explored the data warehouse model and data mining model structure and realization method. It is found that heterogeneous data integration is the basis for financing decision system design, Key lies in the multi-dimensional data warehouse model building, data mining algorithm design and expression. These results are important significance on promoting the construction of enterprise financing decision system, realizing enterprise financing decision automation and intelligent.

articleTitle: Research on distribution logistics problem in decentralized coordinating VMI&TPL supply chain
abstract: A new supply chain model which integrates Vendor-managed inventory (VMI) and Third-party logistics (TPL) is discussed. Decentralized coordinating VMI&TPL supply chain model is built firstly. Based on the network which consists of “many vendors, one TPL and one manufacturer”, distribution logistics problem model of decentralized coordinating integrating supply chain of VMI and TPL is built. A simulated annealing algorithm is designed to solve the problem. At last, a numerical study is given to testify the feasibility of simulated annealing algorithm by comparing with C-w saving method.

articleTitle: Analysis of enterprise resources diffused effect in the parent-subsidiary corporation's network system
abstract: In order to improve the value creativity of parent-subsidiary management, this paper first discusses and defines the nature of enterprise resource relationships and parent-subsidiary corporation. Based on enterprise resources relationships, characteristics of parent-subsidiary corporation are analyzed in detail. Through analyzing the mechanism of resources diffuse, such conclusions can be achieved as follows: the improvement of resource matching and differences between parent and subsidiary, the enhancement of information integrity on resources diffuseness and the development of resources diffused system are benefit for increasing the diffused value of resources between parent and subsidiary, and improving the value creativity of parent-subsidiary management.

articleTitle: Research on oil Camellia industry development of Hubei Province in China based on regional industrial competitiveness
abstract: Based on the theory of regional industrial competitiveness, using comparative, qualitative and quantitative research methods, this paper compared the Oil Camellia industry of Hubei Province and other main producing provinces, and studied its internal conditions and external environment. Hubei Province has disadvantages in the scale of recourses, the conversion of scientific research, the number and yield of processing enterprises. But advantages are the structure of Camellia forest, the expansion of new Camellia forest and the construction of elite germchit bases. In addition, the Oil Camellia industry of Hubei is facing great external opportunities. Through analyzing, this paper puts out the key points to speed up the development of the Oil Camellia industry in order to give some useful advice to Hubei Province.

articleTitle: Research on quantificational appraisal of private enterprises' undertaking of CSR in Ningbo taking determination of indicator weights for example
abstract: It is difficult to scientifically determine weights of appraisal indicators of enterprises' undertaking of Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR). The Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP) provides a feasible way to accurately determine weights of appraisal indicators. The appraisal indicators system for CSR of private enterprises in Ningbo consists of 13 indicators. According to outcome of questionnaire investigation, and by AHP, this paper obtains weights of the 13 indicators. Among these 13 indicators, weights of shareholders' interest maximization, production safety, and quality and safety of products rank the top three, while weights of satisfaction of consumer's demand, charitable donation, and participation in environmental administration rank the last three. So AHP is a good method to determine weights of appraisal indicators.

articleTitle: A study on the producer outsourcing services based on regional pillar industry
abstract: Service outsourcing industry separates industry value chain, and deepens the regional division of labor on the basis of promoting industry specialization. Taking the development of outsourcing industry in Heilongjiang Province for a typical example, the study use evaluation method of PCA and the selection index system of pillar industries. The research shows that seven industries are the leading industries in Heilongjiang Province. Closely focusing on the development of the pillar industries, enterprises should make a good use of technical advantages of traditional industries, and make great effort to develop producer outsourcing services. Meanwhile, the government should take industrial agglomeration as the concept of development. Scientific planning and rational guiding are very important measures to develop service outsourcing industry.

articleTitle: Research on customer service planning of the third party logistics enterprise
abstract: In addition to the daily management, planning future logistics service is very important to the third party logistics enterprise. The main contents of planning are analyzing the current logistics service elements and service level; accurately understanding customer expectations and feedback information; dividing customer groups according to the contribution and potential abilities, and formulating the corresponding policy of logistics services; evaluating the gaps between service ability and customer demand. For the important customers, the third party logistics enterprise can evaluate the service efficiency by DEA model through the appropriate evaluation index system of the inputs and outputs, analyze the gaps between its own level and competitors' level, identify the shortcomings in customer service, and improve customer service level continuously.

articleTitle: Applied research of drawing projection test in personnel selection
abstract: A new psychological evaluation method was studied in personnel selection - drawing projection test, control test method was applied in this paper. In the simulation of recruitment scene, both drawing projection test and normal psychological evaluating scale were adopted to do psychological test for experiment group, and the test results were compared and analyzed. Analysis founds that drawing projection test can let subjects more relaxed and reflect its true inner quality. There are good degree of distinction in the extraversion, initiative, emotions and mental health conditions. The results show that drawing projection test as a psychological evaluation tools used in personnel selection has unique advantages. It can substitute the interpersonal skills test, emotional stability evaluation, mental health status evaluation and other professional scale.

articleTitle: Discussion on status and improvement measures about law and regulations of railway construction in China
abstract: In order to reform and design the new law and standard system, statistical method and comparative approach were applied. The status was investigated through thousands of law and standard documents. The law and regulations of China's railway construction were composed by four parts: law, administrative regulations, department rules and other normative documents. Normative documents take higher ratio of 47%. The government failed to establish clear management systems for standards. Many mandatory standards were not brought into the law system. According to the WTO requirements, the new standard system should combine with the law system and mandatory.

articleTitle: Key areas selection and suggestions study on modern forestry ecological system construction of state-owned forests in Heilongjiang Province
abstract: The state-owned forests in Heilongjiang province made significant contribution to China's economic development, but with a huge price of serious ecological deterioration. So modern forestry construction of the state-owned forest focuses on strengthening the modern forestry ecological system. The key is the selection of key areas of ecological system. This paper takes Yichun state-owned forest for example, builds evaluation index system and factor analysis model to key areas choice of modern forestry ecological system and studying Yichun in Heilongjiang Province. This paper has important studying significance to promote the state-owned forest modern forestry ecological construction.

articleTitle: Study on network model of reverse logistics based on used appliances
abstract: With the increase of household appliances, the recycling of waste appliances becomes an urgent problem to be solved. Based on the characteristics of household appliances, the model of recycling household appliances of reverse logistic networks was designed; which includes the collection point, testing center, remanufacturing plant, waste treatment centre, product distribution centers and sales points. The aim is to obtain the smallest transport costs and optimize reverse logistics networks' establishments of recycling household appliances with genetic algorithms, at last an applied case was given, which shows that genetic algorithm is suitable to establish the optimization model of appliances reverse logistics network.

articleTitle: Application of network multimedia technology in MIS experimental teaching
abstract: Management Information System (MIS) is the core course of management specialty in colleges and universities. However, during the process of developing teaching activities, the effect of experimental teaching is not perfect due to the limitations of teaching mode and teaching means. The paper analyzes characteristics and content of MIS course and discusses network multimedia technology and advantages in MIS experimental teaching. Consequently, the application of network can improve the students' practical operating level and achieve a very good teaching effect.

articleTitle: Law of enterprise strategy synergistic effect evolvement
abstract: To study the evolution of enterprise strategy synergistic effect, this paper defined enterprise strategy synergistic effect and drew mathematical description. Quadratic nonlinearity differential equation is used to depict self-organization evolution process of enterprise strategy synergistic effect. This paper issued that strategy synergistic effect would be in sustainable benign development when the inner endowment growth rate jointly affected by routine factors and transform factors. The evolution period is divided into initial phase, growth phase, maturity phase and transition phase. The results of routine factors and transform factors analysis exhibit different evolution characteristics in different phases. After enterprise strategy changed, strategy synergy patterns was going to change and strategy synergistic effect would evolve in higher management level.

articleTitle: Study on the morale of information sharing of supply chain based on the entrusted agency theory
abstract: Supply chain information sharing can be achieved by a reimbursable information sharing mechanisms. Through using the theory of entrusted agency and a single-task entrusted agency, the paper studies the problem about supply chain information sharing between manufacturers and sellers. The level effecting two sides can be described by a linear relation and income relations, as well as the morale of the contract can be analyzed under symmetrical and asymmetrical information circumstances. Consequently, the enterprises know the values of information sharing clearly, at the same time, the cost of supply chain management can be reduced and the efficiency of the supply chain management can be improved.

articleTitle: A study of low carbon operation model of manufacturing enterprises
abstract: Under the deteriorated condition of environmental issue and resource crisis, low carbon economy that stands for low energy consumption, low emission and low pollution become the mainstream in the future. So the manufacturing enterprises should operate in a low carbon way to acquire the competitive advantage. According to the analysis of this paper, the low carbon operation model consists of low carbon ordinary administration management and low carbon production management. Based on these two dimensions this paper builds the low carbon operation model of manufacturing enterprises. In the operation model, daily administration and production management are the main contents. And the concrete operation of daily administration dimension includes low carbon administration, culture and management system. The production management can be divided into low carbon procurement, low carbon production, low carbon marketing and low carbon product handling.

articleTitle: Inspection on project superviser by real estate developer based on game theory
abstract: The rent-seeking activities can severely deteriorate the quality of projects, increase the operation cost of developers and undermine regular market order. Therefore developers should inspect them to avoid supervisers' rent-seeking activities. This paper applies the game theory approach to analyze the problem. Firstly, this paper provides the expected utility functions of a project superviser and a developer, also establishes the game model and solves the equilibriums. Finally, this paper analyzes the influencing factors of a supervisor's rent-seeking activities and brings some countermeasures of inspection on supervisers according to the results of equilibrium analysis.

articleTitle: Study on evaluation of the satisfaction of university diet work based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model
abstract: In order to objectively evaluate the satisfaction of university diet, the paper introduced the concept of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation at first. And then, the paper was focused on an objective and quantitative evaluation of the satisfaction of university diet work and built a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model. Finally, the paper had a comprehensive evaluation on the satisfaction of university diet work in some university in Yang Zhou, and demonstrated the feasibility and practicality of the method.

articleTitle: University & FDI knowledge spillovers and large & medium-sized industrial enterprises technology innovation — Knowledge production function model based on panel data
abstract: Based on panel data, the paper utilized knowledge production function model to study the knowledge spillover effects of universities R&D and FDI on the technology innovation of the large & medium-sized industrial enterprises (LMSIE). The study has shown that the LMSIE' R&D expenditure, the universities R&D and FDI were helpful to technology innovation of the LMSIE, the universities R&D and FDI have obvious knowledge spillover effects to the technology innovation of LMSIE; The technology absorbing ability of enterprises could significantly affect the knowledge spillover effects of FDI and universities R&D on the LMSIE technology innovation.

articleTitle: Research on air and acoustics pollutions of supermarket in northeast area of China
abstract: With the rapid development of architecture technology, people pay more attention to the environment in the buildings. Supermarket is one kind of special buildings which different from other living and office buildings, and its pollutions have some special characteristics. The paper studies the air and acoustics pollutions in one supermarket located in northeast of China, which is based on the method of subjective evaluation and objective evaluation. The concentration of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and the sound level of talk sound source are very important for the built environment in supermarket. The results of this paper will contribute to the built environment promotion and design of supermarket.

articleTitle: Strategic decisions by IT firm when new technology substitutes old one
abstract: In order to promote its profit, IT firm continually issues new technology. However, the old one still exists and has some power of attraction when the new product enters market. Then how to make new technology substitute old one becomes a critical problem. This paper builds a simple model to analyze the problem. This model focuses on the pricing strategy and compatibility decision of IT firm with considering the characteristics of network externality and the existence of switching cost in IT industry.

articleTitle: Exergy analyses of heat pump drying system
abstract: The technology of drying is centuries-old. It is apparent that drying itself is an energy-intensive process. Heat pump assisted-drying provides a controllable drying environment (temperature and humidity) for better products' quality at low energy consumption. On the exergy analyses of heat pump unit, exergy losses of heat pump four main components (evaporator, compressor, condenser and expansion valve) were studied. The exergy method provides the useful information to choose the appropriate component design and operation procedure.

articleTitle: Study on the Multi-Agent model for PHM system
abstract: Prognostics and Health Management (PHM) attracts more and more attention. The PHM behavior of equipment could be classified into two major parts: Automated part and Human-in-Loop part, the challenge is to construct the Multi-Agent model for the Automated part. Firstly, the critical activities of maintenance process are described with several self-governed agents. Then, the mechanism of communication and interaction among the multiple agents is discussed. Thirdly, the Multi-Agent model for equipment PHM system is put forward. Finally, the task of Mission Planned Agent, Maintenance Decision-making Agent, Resources Management Agent and Learning Agent are analyzed.

articleTitle: On the capital investment risks management an empirical analysis for Heilongjiang province
abstract: As the most important part of economic growth, capital investment has a higher growth rate recently and occupies the amazing share among all the investments. Based on the theory of risks management, the capital investment risk factors were fully analyzed and an index system for the reasonable evaluation of capital investment was brought forward, which aimed at the quantitative and overall evaluation for the capital investment risks. With the help of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model, the detail analysis for risks managements of capital investment proposed the empirical countermeasures regarding the capital investment and all the conclusions passed the empirical discrimination by Heilongjiang province of China.

articleTitle: Evaluation of graduation design's organization structure based on entropy theory
abstract: In order to improve guiding work for graduation design, new guiding organization style was found. The purpose of this paper is to evaluate and compare two organization styles (old and new) from information flow aspect. Based on entropy theory, efficiency entropy and quality entropy were introduced to evaluate the order degree of system structure. Efficiency entropy reflects uncertainty degree of information speed and quality entropy reflects the uncertainty of information transfer quality. Efficiency entropy and quality entropy were calculated according to their definitions for the old and new organization styles and the order degrees were also given. Calculation results show that the new organization structure is better than the old one in view of information flow.

articleTitle: An empirical study on corporate social responsibility and corporate profitability
abstract: More and more enterprises begin to pay attention to social responsibilities and their disclosure. From all the listed companies on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2008, 156 companies were taken as study samples. Based on the data, the correlations and regression analysis were made between each index representative CSR and corporate profitability. The study shows that the CSR for government and staff has a significant positive correlation with corporate profitability. The CSR for investors and social welfare also has positive correlation with it, while the correlation coefficient is not significant. But the CSR for environment has a negative relationship with corporate profitability. So the corporate should bring more benefit to their stakeholders while getting more economic profits, especially to environment protection.

articleTitle: Study on motion planning strategy of a modular self-reconfigurable robot
abstract: Motion planning of a self-reconfigurable robot is not an easy work in complicated environment. A novel relative orientation model was proposed to describe modules and their surrounding grids. A heuristic search planner used macro motion (HSM) and a PR (Pedrail Rolling) planner were developed. The HSM was proposed for a robot which has less than 12 modules and the PR for large number modules. Macro motion based on modular rule database is used to reduce the heuristic search space. PR planner converts large modules reconfiguration to few modules reconfiguration by setting some modules stillness and then uses HSM to plan reconfiguration. Some experiments are done by a robot with initial double line configuration such as traversing stairs, ravines and narrow hole. Experiments results show that the proposed plan strategy can plan modular motion series for any initial configuration to traverse complicated surroundings.

articleTitle: Evaluation on sustainable of housing projects by entropy matter-element analysis
abstract: According to the principle of multi-target extension, matter-element analysis constructed a new evaluation method of sustainable housing projects, which was based on element model, extension theory of mathematical methods and correlation functions. At the same time, the example showed that the entropy theory utilized to calculate the correlation index weights in this new method could also avoid subjective influence in a large extent. This comprehensive method is more reliable and convenient compared with the existing evaluation methods; it can measure the sustainable level of housing projects more objectively and directly.

articleTitle: Research of knowledge management on the university library for subject user
abstract: University library service is an important guarantee for improving the competitiveness of libraries. This paper aims at the level of subject in university, based on the concept of subject-user-centered library knowledge management, analyzes the idea of knowledge and framework of the university library services. The conclusion is that knowledge management for user can strengthen academic collections, construct subject librarians of high-quality team, share subject knowledge service, establish the concept of personalized service innovation, comply with knowledge management and the library service.

articleTitle: An empirical study of characteristics of takeover targets from Chinese capital Market
abstract: This paper constructs a multi-variables logistic model to study characteristics of takeover targets from Chinese capital Market. The theoretical model indicates that Chinese takeover has specific characteristics. The empirical results show that the firm size, net operating loss of target firm and the ownership structure could affect the takeover decision. Specially, the larger proportion of first shareholding and higher concentration are useful to achieve company takeover. However, the effect of tax preference on takeover is not obvious, because the income tax preferences are widespread for Chinese listed companies.

articleTitle: Research on function of government in the flexible network growth of industrial clusters—In the case of Liaoning Province
abstract: On the base of introducing the three-level flexible network growth model the paper systematically analyzes the function of government. In the process the flexible value realization model of industrial clusters is established. As the premise of empirical analysis the flexible Index System of Industrial Clusters is achieved. The elaboration of the function of government contribution in the flexible network growth of industrial clusters includes two important aspects, namely the Independent impact and the compound impact of flexible network to development of industrial cluster with adding government contribution. Finally the paper takes Liaoning Province as the typical example to explain the operation effect and coordination efficiency of government in different flexible network of industrial clusters.

articleTitle: Stability research on fuzzy systems based on efficient maximal overlapped-rules group
abstract: Stability analysis of fuzzy systems is an important research field. In this paper a concept of the efficient maximal overlapped-rules group (EMORG) is defined, and then a relaxed stability condition to T-S fuzzy systems is proposed, which can guarantee the quadratic stability of the open-loop T-S fuzzy systems globally. This condition only requires finding a local common positive definite matrix in each EMORG. Moreover, the proposed stability condition includes previous results as special cases.

articleTitle: Study on uncalibrated algorithm for dynamic visual servoing system
abstract: In order to calibrate cameras and robot models precisely in industrial practice, a novel dynamic uncalibrated eye-in-hand visual servoing system to track a moving target is proposed. The method does not require calibration of camera and robot kinematic models. Visual serving algorithm to track dynamic image is developed through minimizing nonlinear objective function. Because the large residual is not approximated in dynamic environment and the change of composite image Jacobian with time increment can't be computed in visual servoing system now, large residuals are dynamic approximated and the change of composite image Jacobian at each iterative step is computed. Simulation results demonstrate the validity of these approaches.

articleTitle: Construction of the new network financial reporting model based on the event accounting theory and XBRL
abstract: To construct the new network financial reporting model, the paper discusses the principles and elements of new network financial reporting mode. Based on the event accounting theory and XBRL (e Xtensible Business Reporting Language) database, the paper collects overall data on business transaction, centralizes accounting data formats and standards, precise and dynamic data. The successful construction of new network financial reporting model necessarily passes process: structing two-tier XBRL classification database, developing definable program modules, providing interactive tools and other specific steps and processes.

articleTitle: Research on supply chain optimization of foreign food company C
abstract: Food industry in the world economic field has the pivotal status and becomes a pillar of the national economy development. C food company faces the increasingly competitive market. In order to realize the optimization of supply chain company C, the paper analyzes food production and sales link, then constructs feasible optimization scheme of company C. The optimization scheme of supply chain helps food companies reduce production cost, improve product quality and strengthen the competitive advantage.

articleTitle: The index system establishment of expressway quality control based on Hall theory
abstract: In the researches for the expressway quality control, the quality control indicators are often lacking of theoretical support. Aiming at this problem, through a comprehensive analysis of the system engineering, the Hall theory is used to establish the three-dimension structure of the expressway quality control system and further analysis the whole system from the knowledge dimension, the time dimension and the logic dimension. After three rounds of index-selection, the index system is established, which is fit for the expressway quality control management.

articleTitle: The impact of foreign investment on housing prices
abstract: This paper constructs a partial equilibrium of housing flow market to investigate the impact of foreign investment upon housing prices. The theoretical model demonstrates that the inflow of foreign investment will result in the appreciation of house prices. The empirical results illustrate that the foreign investment has a trivial impact on the house prices. In addition, the paper finds that the household income rather that developing cost is the most important fact influencing the urban housing prices. The other findings are as follows: the interest rate policy is nearly invalid; the housing prices in bigger cites is more prone to increase; the substituting effect between rental market and ownership market is weak.

articleTitle: Study on influencing factors of star-hotels in Chongqing based on PCR
abstract: To make clear which factors influence the development of star-hotels, base on 1998-2008 time series data of star-hotels and social economy in Chongqing, 10 indexes were chosen to be analyzed with the method of principal component regression (PCR). Three important conclusions are received. (1) According to their internal relationship, these 10 indexes can be divided into three kinds, economic environment factor, hotel market factor and related industries factor. (2) Main influencing factors of star-hotels are population, output value of tertiary industry, total volume of import and export, GDP, tourism income, tourist number, and total volume of social retail goods. (3) Total population has the greatest influence on the development of star-hotels; for the tourism transfer city, tourism income and tourist number have relatively less influence on star-hotels.

articleTitle: A novel distributed navigation algorithm based on GPS vestiges
abstract: The problems of GPS communication interrupt often leads to failure of navigation pathfinding. In order to realize the effective Fault-tolerance of pathfinding navigation system, a distributed navigation algorithm under GPS vestiges, named as GVDN, is proposed. And its main idea, algorithm model, data structure and running process are described. Furthermore, Monte Carlo method is utilized to evaluate the scheme of the level of passable roads. At last, the algorithm performance is analyzed. The simulation results show that the algorithm has better Fault-tolerance and responsiveness than the traditional algorithm.

articleTitle: Calculating critical degree of the path in a project network with fuzzy activity duration
abstract: In traditional CPM/PERT technique, activity duration must be represented either as crisp number or as random variable drawn from certain probability distribution. However, it is usually difficult to define and estimate precisely the operation time for each activity in a real situation. Based on the liner programming and Zadeh's extension principle, this paper presents a method for measuring critical degree of the path in a project network with fuzzy activity times. In the last, this paper uses matlab language to program, and verifies its feasibility and simplicity by an example.

articleTitle: The analysis of equalization effect of transfer payment to county and township in China
abstract: The effect of transfer payment to county and township is an important issue and should be paid much attention to, since the transfer payment to county and township from the super government is the most important measure to resolve county and township finance difficulty until now. In the paper, the equalization effect of transfer payment to county and township is analyzed from horizontal and longitudinal aspects. During the course of analysis, variation coefficient in statistics and comparative method are employed. The conclusion is that the transfer payment to county and township in China hasn't reached its equalization goal of public finance. On the basis of that, the reform measure of improvement is proposed.

articleTitle: Analysis on science and technology integrated innovation ability of Chinese agricultural enterprises
abstract: The paper analyzes the causes for low integrated innovation ability in science and technology of Chinese agricultural enterprises and aims to build mathematical model methods to analyze the internal causes for integrated innovation ability in science and technology of Chinese agricultural enterprises. The paper also analyzes the existing integrated innovation ability in science and technology of 29 leading enterprises in Harbin city via questionnaire empirical analysis, and the analysis result shows that most of the agricultural enterprises in Harbin city have poor innovation consciousness, lack scientific research input, are unable to innovate product development, rely excessively on the use of introduced technology and are wanting in re-innovation. The internal causes are that enterprises make decisions on the basis of self-profit maximization and are short of internal motive force for technology innovation, thus restricting the process of agricultural technology integrated innovation.

articleTitle: How to face the economic situation in the Russian Far East in the post-crisis era for China
abstract: Influenced by the global financial crisis since later 2008, the economy of Russia has declined across the board. Russian GDP has fallen by about 9% in 2009. In this paper, the economy in Russian Far East grew slowly, however, the overall situation was better than the whole country's situation. With the post crisis era coming, the government and enterprises must have a clear view of local coming socio-economic situations, and prepare fully to meet the risks of trade and investment.

articleTitle: Influence mechanism of performance evaluation of public policy implementation in local government based on system dynamics
abstract: According to primary performance status of public policy implementation in China, this paper researches performance evaluation from two aspects (positive and negative) in macroscopic environment. System dynamics method is adopted to explain the mechanism of these two kinds of effects on our public policy implementation. By computer simulation, the core execution of public policy has constructed the “local government performance evaluation of public policy implementation in the stock and flow model of the overall system dynamics”, and investigates mechanism of performance evaluation of public policy implementation in our local government, in order to reach a more standardized and improved system of public policy.

articleTitle: Research on partnership selection of new product development based on fuzzy mathematics
abstract: Coupled with the fierce market competition, diversity and personality demand for customers, and requiring for higher quality and shorter delivery time, new product development seems to be particularly important for enterprises. Facing this situation, numerous enterprises explore new product development through establishing partnerships with others. Based on fuzzy mathematics theory, analyzed factors influencing partnership selection of new product development and their weight, evaluation index system was established. And analyzed one example applying fuzzy mathematics method, then partners satisfying product development request were singled out.

articleTitle: Real-time collaborative design for cloud computing CAD system
abstract: A new real-time collaborative design technology of cloud computing CAD system is introduced in this paper. By using the cloud computing CAD system with the new technology, multi-designer can do their design in one document at the same time, and exchange design data conveniently. A new document structure used in cloud computing CAD system is given. This is a multi-layer structure, and can be expanded dynamically with the increase of users. The user data permissions between these layers are defined. A CAD system architecture which is built base on the multi-layer document structure is discussed. The system's work flow and the document structure are also shown in the end through an example.

articleTitle: Trust game analysis between partners in the supply chain alliance
abstract: The lack of trust among supply chain alliance partners leads to the low efficiency of overall supply chain, also prevents the application of supply chain management for the enterprise. The paper analyzes the trust relations among partners in the supply chain alliance, discusses the factors affecting alliance trust. Based on the Game theory, the general model of trust for supply chain Alliance is constructed. The alliance partners must consider the long-term benefits and trust each other, then the coalition parties can get the maximum benefit.

articleTitle: The correlations between intellectual capital investment and economic growth: Evidence from 20 provinces & cities of China
abstract: Based on Cobb-Douglas production function, this paper estimated the roles of intellectual capital investment and fixed assets investment in economic growth of 20 provinces and cities in China during 1990–2005. A system of indicators measuring the intellectual capital investment and fixed assets investment were designed and the intellectual capital investment was calculated. Their impacts on economic growth were analyzed via regression, cointegration and panel cointegration analysis separately. It shows Beijing ranks first on the output elasticity to intellectual capital investment (0.73), followed by Guangdong (0.56) in regression model, and the output of intellectual capital investment tends to increase in cointegration model. Additionally, the output of intellectual capital investment is a little higher than that of fixed assets investment. It indicates that the main driving force of economic growth since 2000 is intellectual capital investment.

articleTitle: Structural model of the capability of enterprises sustainable development
abstract: The capability of enterprises sustainable development is the necessary elements for enterprises to achieve sustainable development. It's key to ascertain the elements and their relationship of the capability of sustainable development for enterprises. This paper analyzed the features of sustainable development enterprises, attributed the capability of enterprises sustainable development to six elements of the capability including innovation, controlling, culture, resources, competition and growth on the basis of inductive method, and established the structural model of the above six elements. The research results can play the mirror role of deepening the theory study of enterprises sustainable development.

articleTitle: Network alliance for the total life cycle of reconfigurable machine tool
abstract: The RMT is a kind of application-oriented machine tool, whose manufacturers, suppliers and end users are demanding much more resource to form the supply chains with low cost, high quality and fast delivery, but researches on RMT are still at the design stage. This paper begins with a brief introduction to its characters, and proposes a reconfigurability index calculation method. Then the total life cycle process of RMT and the necessary recourses are analyzed. In order to support the successful development, manufacturing and application of RMT, an approach to build a network alliance (NA) comprised of RMT-related enterprises is proposed. In this alliance, all kinds of manufacturing resources can be shared and all members in alliance can be employed to work collaboratively.

articleTitle: Internal governance and corporate value: Based on panel data of Hebei Province listed companies during 2001–2009
abstract: The paper aims to study the relationship between the internal governance and the corporate value of the listed companies by using the panel data of the listed companies from 2001 through 2009 in Hebei Province. The results indicate that in Hebei Province the ownership concentration which is featured as the majority of the largest shareholders are state-owned, is significantly and positively related with the corporate value. The times of board meetings is correlated with the corporate value, and the stock rights incentive of top managers is significantly and negatively related with the corporate value. The results will offer the guidance to improve the internal governance and enhance the firm value for listed companies in Hebei Province.

Author Keywords: the listed companies of Hebei province

articleTitle: Research about licensing rules of technology alliance
abstract: Technology alliances are an important economic institution which can be defined as formal or informal organizations based on whether for-profit firms share patent rights with each other and third parties. This paper sets the licensing terms associated with technology alliances, whose independent licensing allows no competition for the alliance's offering and furthermore enhances members' incentives to produce innovations. The theoretical framework predicts that (a) alliances consisting of complementary patents are more likely to allow members to engage in independent licensing and (b) that the requirement that firms license patents to the alliance should be associated with alliances that consist of complements and allow independent licensing. This paper then examine these patterns in a regression analysis and use a logit specification, with a dummy variable denoting a alliance that required alliances as the dependent variable. This paper theoretically examines the licensing rules associated with technology alliances.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation Index System of R&D Industry: A case study on Pudong New Area, Shanghai
abstract: As a new type of industry, the basis of statistical evaluation of R&D industry is relatively weak. Shanghai's R&D industry is facing important opportunities because Shanghai Future Long-term Science and Technology Planning clearly set the goals of enhancing the knowledge competitiveness in the world. Therefore, the Evaluation Index System of R&D Industry in Shanghai was established, which includes input evaluation index class, output evaluation index class, support evaluation index class and a total of 15 indexes. Nine representative indexes were selected to evaluate the specialization and globalization of R&D Industry in Shanghai. The Pudong New Area 247 R&D enterprises were surveyed. Based on these data, the indexes' values of the specialization and globalization of Pudong New Area R&D industry were calculated. Percentage of Pudong New Area R&D industry expenditures to its total sales revenue reaches 4.02%, higher than the R&D input intensity of major developed countries. The results show that the degree of R&D Industry specialization of Pudong New Area is high.

articleTitle: Open source and proprietary software: The social welfare analysis
abstract: The social welfare differs from a software market when monopolized by open source software (OSS) and proprietary software (PS) were investigated by modifying Cournot model. Assuming the market exhibits network externality and software user expectations are fulfilled or myopic, the results show that the social welfare of the market monopolized by OSS may be lower than that of this market monopolized by PS. Therefore the social planner should not unconditionally encourage open source software when developing the software industry policy. Moreover, the probability of “the social welfare of the market monopolized by OSS is lower (or higher) than that of this market monopolized by PS” may be affected by user's software development skill, OSS's learning (maintenance or development) cost and network externality.

articleTitle: Economic effect of separation between cash flow rights and controlling rights of ultimate shareholders—Evidence from private-listed companies in China
abstract: Based on ultimate shareholder's views, five hypotheses were proposed. Using method of least squares, regression models were set up. Data of this research comes from private listed companies in Shanghai stock markets from 2004-2008. The paper examines the effects of ultimate shareholder's controlling rights, cash flow rights and the separation between them on corporate performance and capital structure. The paper aims to give some suggestions on interests protection of minority shareholders in China. Results show that: (1) Controlling rights are negatively related to corporate performance, and cash flow rights are positively related to it. The performance decreases with the separation degree of the two rights. (2) Controlling rights and cash flow rights are negatively related to the size of debt financing.

articleTitle: The cooperation in agri-food supply chain
abstract: Cooperation plays an important role in Agri food supply chain, it's important to research on promoting cooperation in agri-food supply chain. Agri-food supply chain has three main stages: production, process and marketing. In order to guarantee quality and stabilization of price, horizontal cooperation usually exists in production stage, while vertical cooperation usually exists in different stages. A model is built to explain the barrier of cooperation and adopt transaction-cost perspective. Finally, the conclusion verifies the importance of cooperation in agri-food supply chain.

articleTitle: Foodservice supplier selection based on data envelopment analysis
abstract: Supplier selection of foodservice industry becomes one of the universal concerns in the background of supply chain management. To solve the problem of strategic decision-making process, a supplier selection index system based on chain catering industry was established in the paper, and the relevance between indexes was reduced by factor analysis. Foodservice suppliers were analyzed with the decision-making model. Further more, life cycle of enterprise development was introduced to achieve the dynamic selection of supplier, which makes contribution to the integration of food supply chain. Finally, the method of supplier dynamic selection was tested and verified by a numerical example. The result showed that this kind of supplier selection method is applicable to chain catering industry.

articleTitle: Optimization model of credit asset portfolio based on Z-Score
abstract: Based on financial status of loan customers, considering the constrain on laws, and regulations, using portfolio profits maximum of bank's assets as objective function, the optimal model of asset-liability-management is set up, in order to provide decision-making method for bank's risk management. The characteristic is that the financial status of loan customers is measured by Z-Score model, which can reflect the probabilities of the credit default in the future. Case study shows that the optimization model of credit asset portfolio based on Z-score is better than the existing studies in the return per unit of risk on the asset portfolio.

articleTitle: Empirical analysis on the financial fragility of the United States based on factor analysis method
abstract: Based on financial data from 1997 to 2008 of the United States, this paper selected 15 relative indicators to valuate financial fragility of the United States by using the factor analysis method. The result shows that the financial fragility of the United States has getting worse from 2002. By 2007, it has been very serious. Among the factors which have effected on the financial fragility of the United States, the most determining factor is the domestic macro-economic environment, then the domestic financial development level. The paper explained the explosion of the US sub-prime crisis from the perspective of the financial fragility.

articleTitle: Benefit mechanism designing: For coordinating three stages supply chain
abstract: Coordination mechanism based on the three levels of supply chain consists of a single vendor, a single manufacturer and a single seller. Three levels of supply chain are used firstly for the coordination of supply chain by quantitative method. The strategies to fix price are discussed using Game theory, as a single vendor, a single manufacturer and a single sellers are in the cooperation of the independent decision-making and cooperation of the collective decisions. The interests of two strategies for the enterprises are also involved. The result shows that the integrated interest of the supply chain under the cooperation case is larger than that in the supply chain of not cooperation case. The supply chain node cooperation between enterprises is superior than not cooperation in enterprises own interests, as distributive factors must be taken from some range. Core businesses could choose appropriate distributive factors in order to reach the harmony of interest and get the overall stability of high interest, which depends on the power of bargaining.

articleTitle: Research on the relationship between the illusion of control and customer satisfaction in customer participation
abstract: The theory of illusion of control was introduced to explain why customers were dissatisfied in customer participation. Through two experiments, the customer participated situations were simulated for two groups of subjects. In these situations, customers overestimated the influences of participated behaviors to outcome. Once outcomes were not in accordance with expectations, compared with customers who did not participate, participated customers were markedly dissatisfied. However, the level of customer participation had not significant effect to illusion of control. Participated customers produce illusion of control. Consistency of outcomes between expectations moderates the relation between illusion of control and customer satisfaction. The findings provide considerable evidence for customer psychological change in customer participation.

articleTitle: The analysis on the incentive mechanism of the service outsourcing industry cluster principal-agent model
abstract: To tackle asymmetric information, agent ineffectiveness existing in the service outsourcing industry, the paper takes secondary subcontracting services inside the clusters into consideration, which discusses the effectiveness of incentives in principal-agent model of outsourcing. The game models are put forward. According to the results,the constraints range of incentives that the outsourcing contract-issuing party gives to the service outsourcing contract-undertaking party can be calculated. The incentives which are offered by outsourcing contract-issuing party are invalid and below the lowest bound. Meanwhile, when incentives are above the highest bound, outsourcing contract-issuing party can choose subcontract to maximize its benefits.

articleTitle: The concession term decision-making model for urban rail transit PPP project based on SB-O-T mode
abstract: In the urban rail transit PPP project based on SB-OT mode, the determination of the concession term is the most critical factor to decide whether the project will succeed or not. The urban rail transit PPP project based on SB-OT mode is studied in this paper, where the influence factors of the project concession term are considered and the dynamic technical and economic method is used to analyze the optimal decision-making problem for the project company and government. The concession term decision-making model is established when the concession term is determined on the basis of ascertainment of project investment scale, which provides a method of theoretical analysis for decision-making analysis of the concession term of urban rail transit PPP project. The feasibility and practicability of the model is verified by the example.

articleTitle: The study of family business growth—Base on the viewpoint of trust game between family business and professional managers
abstract: Particularism-based clan trust restricts family business growth in China. The result of trust game is that as long as the additional revenue x obtained by disloyal professional manager is less than 1/i of revenue b by loyal, cooperation between the family business and professional manager can be achieved, and trust can be established. By extension, if a society has perfect legal system, code of ethics and value system, universalism-based society trust can be built step by step. The society trust creates out society capital which is one kind of dynamic and self-growing capital. Society capital can become the permanent motive power of family business growth.

articleTitle: Analytic hierarchy process applications in the construction of the project tender
abstract: This paper stated the impact of the application of the analytic hierarchy process (referred to as the AHP) factors on construction project bidding. In order to eliminate subjective factors on the results of the tender, indicators (program) is obtained by pairwise comparing the importance of the weight of each index, and determine the pros and cons of each program sort. Finally the evaluation and determination of the fair and scientific method determine the successful tender.

articleTitle: The precaution for moral hazard in supply chain
abstract: The moral hazard in supply chain not only increase the management cost, but also enhance the inside consume, finally decrease the integrative competition ability. As a result, prevent and avoid the moral hazard of the supply chain is an important research aspect. Through revealing the deep incentives of moral hazard in supply chain, and determining reasonable precautions could make the moral hazard of supply chain in a safe range, to ensure the normal operation of the supply chain. From the internal system in supply chain to the external system, analyze the incentives of supply chain, based on the Tirole model, and build a dynamic alliance incomplete-information game model in the frame of principle-agent theory to prevent moral hazard in supply chain. The conclusion is drawn that moral hazard can be prevented through designing a kind of distribution policy by the third-party system.

articleTitle: Analysis into factors of dynamical modes of manufacturing process innovations
abstract: This paper probes into the influential factors of dynamical modes of manufacturing process innovation, which are analyzed from five aspects including technology, supply, demand, industrial organization, and macroscopic economy. It is positive connection between the five influential factors to dynamical modes of process innovation and influential factors to process innovation. The five influential factors are the basement of building-up to dynamical modes of process innovation. Based on the analysis of current research situation to dynamical modes of process innovation, the author delivers a review and prospect on the development and fields of researches of dynamical modes of process innovation, and points out that dynamic, systematic, and farseeing should be three most important characters to dynamical modes of process innovation in the future.

articleTitle: A manufacturing process management platform for single-piece and small-batch production
abstract: In single-piece and small-batch production enterprise, the product manufacturing process often needs change and production scheduling problem is complicated. According to the development process of single-piece and small-batch product (SSP), a collaborative platform via network based manufacturing environment for SSP development is proposed in this paper. The main structure of the platform and the cooperation process between each application modules are proposed. Moreover, a kind of dynamic job shop scheduling algorithm is presented. The algorithm is used to realize fast response and adjustment when production or plan changed. Finally, a prototype system that supports SSP manufacturing process management is developed.

articleTitle: Supply chain optimization of combine transporting with inventory
abstract: To equilibrate the physical material in the process of inventory and transportation in supply chain operation, and to make them optimize, a multi-objective optimization model is constructed by using fuzzy mathematics, in which transportation and inventory are considered together. Through analyzing, the results are shown that the total cost of transportation can be saved effectively and the multi-objective optimization model is feasible.

articleTitle: Efficiency formation of National Innovation System: A project view
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to discuss the mechanism of efficiency formation of NIS. In view of project, NIS could be regarded as an innovation projects portfolio. Using methodology of system analysis, the result of this paper is: There are three hierarchies including element hierarchy, project hierarchy and system hierarchy; three efficiency variables named as element efficiency, integration efficiency and structure efficiency and there are three key processes for each variable. Based on this framework, the conclusion is to improve the efficiency of integration and structure of NIS for China.

articleTitle: Research on cooperation investment between port enterprises
abstract: In recent years, cooperation investment on port operation becomes a hot topic. On the basis of satisfaction degree functional model, in this paper, the utility functional model regarding cooperation investment between port enterprises is established and solved with numeric example by adopting genetic algorithms. The model established is benifical to analyze the investment and motivation of port enterprises.

articleTitle: A VMI model and its performance in supplier-driven supply chain
abstract: This paper aims to analyze the effects of VMI on supply chain performance and announce the important function of VMI in promoting supply chain coordination, reducing costs and increasing profit. This research builds a VMI inventory decision model of supplier-driver supply chain. According to this model, VMI is found always to reduce the system's(buyer and supplier together) and the buyer's inventory related costs in the short-term, but the supplier's inventory related costs varies. Under certain cost conditions between buyer and supplier, VMI can increase the system's and the buyer's profit. And the supplier's profit can be increased under other conditions.

articleTitle: The impact of organizational supply chain network on information system: An integrated approach toward information system formulation and improvement
abstract: In order to manage and control organizational information flow effectively, information system (IS) is developed to operate a collection of data structured according to the needs of a company. The paper proposes a framework showing how the organizational IS affect the organizational supply chain activities. This paper also proposes an integrated approach toward organizational IS formulation and improvements. Through using IT, the role of organizational information system is hoped to facilitate organizational users to handle the business problems they face, develop competitive advantage and seek future business opportunities.

articleTitle: Inventory control based on a real-moment dynamic model
abstract: To avoid abuses of the two classic inventory control method, inventory management problem was regarded as continuous system based on the method of modern control theory. Stock of a moment was defined as a control variable and productivity of that moment was defined as state variables. Then a real-moment dynamic model was built and the objective function was given. After that, the optimal control was solved out based on the Hamilton function, thus the optimal inventory in continuous production conditions was presented.

articleTitle: Multi-agent simulation for the evolution of enterprise community in the network society based on Swarm and EGT
abstract: The purpose of this research is to address the evolution of enterprise communities in the network society. Based on evolutionary game theory (EGT) and complex adaptive system (CAS) theory, this paper built an evolutionary game model of enterprise communities, and realized the simulation by Swarm. The results show that the evolution of enterprise communities is a dynamic adaptive process. Under the assumption of limited rationality, the enterprise communities gradually find the optimal strategy through adaptive learning, and finally the evolution reaches an equilibrium stage.

articleTitle: Research on cooperative partner selection process of supply chain
abstract: Select the competitive cooperative partners is important to reach success of supply chain construction. This paper takes system thoughts as dominant, designs phases of the cooperative partners selection in supply chain construction concretely, constructs the enterprise comprehensive competitiveness intelligent assessment system and supply chain operating performance assessment system, which could provide new system thoughts and intelligent decision-making for cooperative partners selection of supply chain.

articleTitle: Impact of corporate wealth on corporate financing —Corporate wealth is entrepreneurial ability' signal
abstract: To find the root cause why it's more difficult for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) to obtain loans from banks, this paper presents a new credit model from the point of view that corporate wealth is the signal of entrepreneurial ability. The result shows if there is no other mechanism to show the entrepreneurial ability under asymmetric information, Banks' assessment of the entrepreneurial ability is an increasing function of corporate wealth. And moral hazard behavior is more likely to appear by shorten of corporate wealth when the collateral is also shorted. So banks can set higher collateral requirements for SMEs in order to achieve the same expected return. Furthermore, the collateral requirement can be lowered in a relationship financing model, however, if there is no better mechanism other than corporate wealth to reveal entrepreneurial ability in the first phrase, the financing dilemma for SMEs can not be changed.

articleTitle: A management information system for product maintainability improvement
abstract: Maintainability is an important design character of product. How to improve the product's maintainability at design stage can reduce or eliminate maintenance costs, reduce downtime, and improve safety. In this paper, a virtual reality based on information management system for product maintainability improvement during design process is developed. The system aims at providing a simulated environment and concurrent engineering processes to facilitate communication, coordination, control and integration of product maintainability validation and improvement activities. The result of this research will help increase product maintainability, reduce development cycle time and cost, and hence increase product marketability.

articleTitle: The countermeasures against fraud in the financial report of listed company
abstract: In the perspective of the internal governance structure and external environment, this paper finds out the research methods about Chinese company's financial reporting frauds based on the related studies and the actual conditions of stock market in China, and applying specification methods. These frauds include the scarcity of corporate governance structure, the poor quality of the accounting personnel, the independence lack of registered accountants, the imperfection of account rule and the poor supervision of government section etc. The paper proposes some policies and countermeasures. It's extremely important to raise the quality of the financial report, safeguard the interests of investors and optimize the configuration capital markets resources.

articleTitle: Study on agent-based early warning modeling for SC enterprise into SDN
abstract: To respond to economic globalization effectively and to support open cooperation among enterprises under dynamic complex market environment, an innovative enterprise management model-supply and demand network(SDN) has been presented. But for enterprise applying SDN is a behavior of enterprise reform with risks. To help more enterprises with SDN smoothly, a model based on agent for early-warning of risks are studied. Firstly, the transformation process goals and the index system have been studied by analytic hierarchy process. Secondly, Agent modeling is used to design intelligent early warning function structure. Finally, considering the application of this Agent model, databases constructing and evaluating formulas of indexes are focused on. This study provides some reference to enhance the capability of recognition risks and risks management for this enterprise reform.

articleTitle: Greetings from General Chairman
abstract: It is my great pleasure to invite you to attend the 2011 International Conference on Management Science and Industrial Engineering (MSIE2011). I cordially welcome you to the MSIE 2011, hosted by Harbin University of Science and Technology (HUST) and sponsored by IEEE Harbin Section, Harbin University of Commerce (HUC) and China Society of Commodity Science (CSCS).

articleTitle: The current situation and strategy research on internal control of enterprises — Jiangsu Province as an example
abstract: A systematic study on internal control of enterprises was carried out. Selected enterprises in Jiangsu Province were studied. Many companies are still in the initial stage of their internal control management, lacking of scientific and modern management. In order to meet the requirements of rapid business development, companies need a qualitative leap of management. Enterprises depends on not only the reformation of the external system, but also the strengthen of the internal control management, by means of scientific methods and management control which can enhance the quality of enterprises. In this way, the internal control fragment of enterprises should be builded up. The internal control environment should be created. The construction of risk evaluation and internal control supervision have to be reinforced. Good control activity and reliable message delivery system ought to be set up and executed.

articleTitle: Evaluation method on R&D alliance patent risk based on cloud model
abstract: Patent risk evaluation is the premise of patent risk control for R&D alliance and it plays an important role in reducing risks and improving patent output. From the five aspects of patent technology risk, patent right risk, patent implementation risk, cooperation risk and environmental risk, the patent risk evaluation index was designed and then its evaluation method based on cloud model was constructed. After that, an empirical analysis of X alliance was made which showed that this method could not only assess the patent risk level but also find the major influencing factors. This research may provide support for R&D alliance to scientifically identify the patent risk factors and accurately grasp the patent risk level so as to take effective measures to prevent risks and reduce the loss.

articleTitle: The optimization method of financial statements based on accounting management theory
abstract: This paper develops an approach to enhance the reliability and usefulness of financial statements. International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) was fundamentally flawed by fair value accounting and asset-impairment accounting. According to legal theory and accounting theory, accounting data must have legal evidence as its source document. The conventional “mixed attribute” accounting system should be replaced by a “segregated” system with historical cost and fair value being kept strictly apart in financial statements. The proposed optimizing method will significantly enhance the reliability and usefulness of financial statements.

articleTitle: Tourism and hotel management: A case study in Iran
abstract: Today more than 80% of the Iran's revenue comes from the oil exported to the other countries in the world. It's quite apparent that oil is considered as a source that one day will be gone. Oil is unable to bring a bright future as a foundation of the economy. The purpose of this study is to bring in light the current situation of Iran from the exceptional tourism opportunities point of view, and the reasons of not being successful in attracting tourists. This paper addressed the issue by using the analytical and descriptive method. The results indicate that the main reasons for the tourism industry not being successful and not being able to attract tourists is the lack of management in organizing and operation of the permanent resource.

articleTitle: Application of Projection Pursuit Model in civil servants' performance assessment
abstract: To assess civil servants' performance involves a number of indices, each index weight is difficult to identify and the result is tend to be interfered by subjective factors. Therefore, the Projection Pursuit Classification Model (PPC) and a Real coded Accelerating Genetic Algorithm (RAGA) are presented to convert the problem from multi-dimensional to one-dimensional subspace and solve the multi-dimensional global optimization problem. According to projection values assess civil servants' performance. It is easy to make decision, the result is relatively objective, and the projection values are dispersed. PPC provides a new approach to assess the civil servants' performance.

articleTitle: Study on energy consumption ingredients and economic growth in Henan based on co-integration and granger test
abstract: Taking Henan as an example, using co-integration analysis and Granger causality test, on the basis of the data of 1980–2008, this paper discusses the relationship between the main energy consumption ingredients and the economic growth in Henan province. The result shows that there is a stable positive equilibrium relationship between the petroleum and gas consumption and the economic growth in the long term, and in one direction from the economic growth to energy consumption; but no any Granger causality between the economic growth and the coal and electrical power consumption.

articleTitle: Review of the measurement to customer citizenship behaviors
abstract: Previous research suggested that customer citizenship behaviors can improve service quality and performance of firms. How to measure customer citizenship behaviors and whether the scales influence the accuracy and scientificity of empirical study. The paper made a retrospect about related literatures about customer citizenship behaviors, reviewed applied scales, analyzed the scales from reliability and validity, and throw out suggestions for developing and applying localization scales.

articleTitle: The construction of efficient E-Government to establish brand-new service-oriented government management model
abstract: E-Government is beneficial to the information publicity of all-level governments, to solve public problems and achieve the public interest as the objective. E-Government should construct brand-new service-oriented government management model. The new model of government functions and government activities and government concept can help make the government become a public service government, and realize the transition from the traditional control government to a service-oriented government. the transparency of management, the convenience of services and the improvement of efficiency must be improved, only in this way can realize the transformation of supervise-oriented government to service-oriented government and establish incorruptible, diligent, practical and efficient government, E-Government has provided important device for the establishment of public-centered and service-oriented government model.

articleTitle: Innovative cultivation and management of cross-disciplinary foreign language talents in export-oriented enterprise in China
abstract: This paper aims to establish an effective model of cross-disciplinary foreign language talents cultivation and management in export-oriented enterprises in China. This paper firstly analyses the characteristics of foreign language talents that these enterprises desire and the conflicts between the enterprises' talents demands and the talents supply. Thus, based on analysis, this paper puts forward an innovative and comprehensive three-dimensional model of foreign language talents' cultivation and management for export-oriented enterprises, which involves the co-efforts of institution of higher learning, enterprise and government.

articleTitle: On the analysis of income approach for real estate
abstract: Real estate industry has always been popular as a key industry at home and abroad. This paper aims at researching on the fast development and soaring housing prices of real estate industry. Based on various forms of income approach, the paper got the advantages and disadvantages of the method. The opinions and suggestions of improvement are put forward by this paper, which enhances the application of income approach in real estate prices sphere. The results of this paper will contribute to the development of real estate in China.

articleTitle: Investigation of current practice in preconstruction planning
abstract: The aim of this paper is to investigate current practice in preconstruction planning. Eleven semi-structured interviews were conducted over a four-month period. Through these interviews, two major findings were revealed: first, guesses are frequently made in preconstruction planning process, neither the initial planner nor the downstream planner will later check. They're usually ignored and left until the execution of the plan, when the problems reveal themselves. Secondly, the current techniques for the management of preconstruction planning, such as the critical path method and bar charts, cannot account for the iterative nature of the preconstruction planning process that requires estimations to be made and work to be redone until a satisfactory solution is developed. This paper argues the importance of effective management of information flow in a preconstruction planning process and the need to improve the management of preconstruction planning. A proposed approach using a dependency structure matrix tool to support the management of preconstruction planning was then introduced.

articleTitle: Study on type identification and policies of foreign investment attractiveness of provinces in China based on principal component analysis
abstract: Foreign investment has become an integral part of our country's economic development. This paper does factor analysis on each index about foreign investment. The result shows that Shanghai, Tianjin and Beijing are ahead of the overall development level in China from the aspect of economic power. The infrastructures are relatively sound and can provide the necessary services for foreign investment. Yunnan, Hebei, Henan, etc have obvious advantages in investment cost. Overall, Shanghai, Tianjin, Beijing are leading the way in the comprehensive capacity of foreign investment attractiveness. Strengthen the government's macroeconomic regulation, give full play to the role of market mechanisms, strengthen the leading of regional distribution and increase the self-innovation input, to enhance the comprehensive capacity in provincial areas.

articleTitle: Study on the green food industry marketing strategy in Heilongjiang Province under e-commerce environment
abstract: Green food is one of the leading industries of economic development in Heilongjiang province with huge potential market demand, however, the traditional marketing strategy is difficult to break the geographical barriers, and the mismatch between production and sales has become the main bottleneck of industrial sustainable development. Based on e-commerce environment, the paper analyzes the advantages and factors for developing green food industry in Heilongjiang. Consequently, the marketing bottleneck of the development of green food industry in Heilongjiang can effectively eliminate, and the sustainable development of industry becomes inevitable.

articleTitle: Research on the relationship among career plateau, organizational commitment and job performance
abstract: The purpose is to verify career plateau and organizational commitment impact on job performance. The study was accomplished by using in-depth interviews and a questionnaire. The results of the study shows that there are significant negative correlations between career plateau and organizational commitment, organizational commitment has a great role in promoting the job performance, organizational commitment fully mediates the influence of content plateau and centralizing plateau on job performance, and also partially mediates the influence of hierarchical plateau on performance. Research also revealed that in order to improve performance enterprise should pay attention to training the corporate identity of staff, and implement job rotation system, dilute the promotion view of staff, effectively alleviate the pressure of promotion.

articleTitle: Research on location of fresh milk collection station—Based on integer programming
abstract: Location is the core issue to construct a fresh milk collection station, which directly affects the benefits of both dairy processing enterprises and dairy farmers. This paper firstly defines the major elements concerning to the location of a fresh milk collection station, then picks up several locations by these elements from a bunch of candidates, and then uses a model set up by integer programming to find the best one. The paper also applies a real case to certify that this model can solve the location problem of a fresh milk collection station effectively.

articleTitle: Block model analysis of the inter-regional knowledge exchange in China
abstract: Taking advantage of the Chinese patent data in the US Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO), this paper examines characteristic of inter-regional knowledge exchange patterns in China from 1985 to 2007. The block model analysis reveals the inter-regional network of China appears some characteristics of core-periphery structure. The most active knowledge exchange occurred in members of the core block composed by the most advanced provinces in China while the members of the periphery block from less favored regions have few or no local and extra-local knowledge exchange. Building a successful knowledge transfer networks would improve much the innovation capacities in less favored regions and help them break from their “locked-in” development trajectories.

articleTitle: Research on business process simulation method of architecture based on IDEF3
