abstract: To acquire the method of business process simulation of architecture, the article introduces the concept, element and function of simulation of architecture, does the research of business process simulation model structure of architecture based on IDEF3(ICAM (Integrated Computer Aided Manufacturing) DEFinition method 3), includes process model, resource model, time model, organization model, junction and link model, presents the steps to analyze the complex system based on the business process simulation method of architecture, the character of the SA(System Architect) tool. The method of article can evaluate system requirements, rationality of campaigning rule expediently, and has theoretical guidance significance to the research of business process simulation.

articleTitle: A study of interaction between loans of financial institutions and technological innovation of the high-tech industries
abstract: Based on the data from 1995 to 2008, this paper sets up a VAR model which makes research on the dynamic relationship between loans of financial institutions and technological innovation of the high-tech industries. The result shows that there is a long-term stable balance relationship between loans of financial institutions and technological innovation of the high-tech industries. Loans of financial institutions has an important driving effect on scientific and technological innovation of the high-tech industries, but no Granger causality relationship has been found. The imbalance between the risk and profit is the main reason why the financial institutions reduce loans to the high-tech industries.

articleTitle: Game analysis of agent incentive and supervision problem
abstract: By using game theory and making an equilibrium analysis, the effect of incentive and supervision in overcoming the shortcomings of agent is analyzed. The paper analyzed how to make incentive and supervision mechanism more effective. Taking executive stock options as an example, as a long-term equity incentive way, the paper analyzes how to make the rational principal and agent achieve Nash equilibrium of (incentive, efforts). Finally, some revelations are got to combine with actual situation of China.

articleTitle: Dynamic decision making in social security system
abstract: This paper studies the decision behavior of workers and characteristics of retirement age in social security system. Based on overlapping-generation model and Markov decision process, this paper constructs a dynamic decision model for social security system. In this model, workers choose their optimal retirement age taking into account the current social security system. In addition, this paper analyzes the equilibrium results. In the end, experiment simulation shows that social security system has some effects on the retirement behavior of workers.

articleTitle: Cluster supply chain switching system model and robust H∞ control strategy
abstract: In the context of cluster supply chain, a new type of cluster supply chain switching system models was established based on the different replenishment forms between two single-chain, which included four inventory subsystems and one switching rule. By applying robust H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> control method, the control law was provided for the corresponding system to restrain operation fluctuation caused by inventory switching processes and the bullwhip effect arising from external uncertain demand. The computation of the control law and a system simulation was performed. Corresponding results show that H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> control strategy effectively restrain inventory and ordering fluctuation caused by switching process and bullwhip effect, therefore guarantee the robust stability of the switching system, which provide the theoretical basis for the cluster supply chain managers.

articleTitle: The design of incentive contracts for preventing moral hazard in the dynamic alliance
abstract: In the case of asymmetric information, there are some principal-agent problems between dominant enterprise and member enterprises in the dynamic alliance. In the context of bounded rationality, “indiscreet behaviors” of member enterprises bring on moral hazard for the union. According to contract theory, the principal-agent model was applied to devise two incentive contracts: pure incentive contract and mixed-incentive contract with incentive and supervision in order to avoid risks and maximize whole performance of the union. Through analysis and comparison of these two contracts, this research analyzed their respective characteristics, probed into the influence on different factors to the optimal beneficial effort level of the partner enterprises and the optimal integrated supervision intensity of the dominant enterprise, and deeply dissected the relation between the optimal incentive intensity and the optimal integrated supervision intensity with a view to providing an effective analytical tool for the solution of moral hazard in the dynamic alliance.

articleTitle: A research on the evaluation of enterprise innovation system
abstract: Enterprise innovation system (EIS) comprises technology innovation, strategy innovation, culture innovation, organization innovation, marketing innovation, management innovation and the others. At present EIS shows the characteristics of openness and multi-agents based on innovation stakeholder. The effective and accurate evaluation of EIS depends on rational selection of the target, the model, index system and the method of the evaluation. This article constructs evaluation model of EIS from the view of enterprise innovation actions process, whose evaluation target is innovation capability, designs corresponding evaluation index system, selects close value method as the specific evaluation method. Close value method is an optimum seeking method for multi-objective decision-making, which can integrate multi-targets into a single target to measure overall, and then sort for the evaluation. When the close value is smaller, corresponding innovation capability of the enterprise is stronger. The evaluation model reflects that innovation stakeholders have important effect on EIS, and emphasizes relatively on innovation actions adaptability to external environment.

articleTitle: Study on the success criteria of large-scale public sector development projects based on whole life cycle
abstract: The success criteria of large-scale public projects is an important aspect of public project management. To systematically define the success criteria of large-scale public projects, achieving the balance of interests of stakeholders will help to properly evaluate the performance of the project. Based on current studies and life cycle management theory, the conceptual model of success criteria of large-scale public projects was constructed. Followed by success criteria from the construction, operation and multi-value, the success of large-scale public projects for micro and macro was evaluated through three dimensions above. It is pointed out that the success criteria of large-scale public projects is dynamic, and the relative importance of different dimensions of success criteria depends on the different stages of life cycle.

articleTitle: Game for government and forestry enterprise of the supervision and management behaviors
abstract: At present, the contradictory conflict exists between government and forestry enterprise in forestry management objectives. This paper studies the effect of the supervision cost and punishment on the game behaviors between government and forestry enterprise. Four types of game were studied in this paper, including complete information static game, complete information dynamic game, incomplete information static game and incomplete information dynamic game. The results indicated that the Nash equilibrium of complete information static game is related to the income and punishment of forestry enterprise to take illegal management and the loss and supervising cost of government. Under complete information dynamic condition, the game player who firstly takes strategies has disadvantage. The game result of incomplete information static game is same to that of complete information static game. Under incomplete information dynamic condition, forestry enterprise trends to take illegal strategies. This paper proposed that government should construct the encouraging and supervising mechanisms and further perfect the forestry cutting rights, forestry resources information and supervising systems.

articleTitle: Correlation analysis of technology innovation and ecologicalization level
abstract: Based on the literature review and analysis, the paper constructs an evaluation index system of enterprise technology innovation and ecologicalization, uses the gray correlation method and information entropy to calculate the correlation between technology innovation and ecologicalization level in the pharmaceutical manufacturing field. The finding is that enterprise ecologicalization level most linked with the number of scientific institutions, and the least linked with the degree of digestion and absorption of funds. Also, the paper made a dynamic analysis of these major factors which pointed out that enterprises should increase the business from the establishment of scientific institutions, and increase investment in eco-technology innovation, attention to technology absorption and innovation, the development of new products and markets, and several other aspects of the work to improve technological innovation and enterprise ecologicalization level.

articleTitle: Research on material distribution model of iron and steel enterprise reducing cost of hot metal
abstract: For a large scale iron and steel enterprise, to optimize the purchasing cost without lowering the grade is difficult. To reduce the cost of hot metal is more effective than to reduce the purchasing cost. This paper uses the material distribution model combined with production process to change the hot metal cost of each BF, and then to reduce average cost of hot metal. The calculation results based on the real production data show that the model can reduce cost of hot metal effectively.

articleTitle: Intervention study on team members' emotions — From communication and psychological empowerment perspective
abstract: Aiming to examine whether team member's emotions can be intervened by changing the level of communication and psychological empowerment, a two multiplied by two experiment with scenario method was carried out. The result is that when communication and psychological empowerment levels change respectively or jointly, team member's emotions differences are significant. The conclusion is as follows: The improvement in communication or psychological empowerment improves team member's emotions; The effect is more significant when communication and psychological empowerment affect team member's emotions jointly.

articleTitle: Research on brand switching behavior of addictive goods consumers
abstract: This paper focuses on developing a classification system and a brand switching model of the addictive goods consumers. Main reasons of switching behavior are analyzed by applying critical incident technique. Based on the grounded theory, the critical incidences are coded and classified. A survey is conducted covering eight different cities of China to test the validity of the classification system and the switching model. The analytical results demonstrate that: (1) most of brand switching behaviors are caused by multi-reasons; (2) five critical factors and their interactions moderate the brand switching behavior: the changes of self-concept; poor perceived quality of goods and services; influence of the primary groups; brand mismanagement, and health concerns. The results suggest corporate and public management of brand switching behavior should stress the roles of consumers' self-concept and the influence of their primary groups.

articleTitle: Workshop facility layout design based on the central point of material handling
abstract: In order to simplify the optimization on workshop facility layout, a new approach is proposed in this paper by dividing the facilities in workshop to several rectangular production cells and introducing the concept of central point of material handling. Based on this idea, the objective function in aiming to minimize the cost of material handling is established and genetic algorithm method is applied in optimizing the solution. The proposed approach was applied to a case study and results show that the method could enhance the enterprise's ability in facility design in reducing the cost of material handling easily.

articleTitle: The logistic strategy based on e-commerce
abstract: As the existing logistics industry develops in society, the top level of service becomes the target of the logistic corporations under the circumstance of e-commerce. It's necessary to make some new ways of logistics management. The paper discusses the specific measures and service of logistic improvement of e-commerce, then proposes the innovation of logistics management under the circumstances of B2C and B2B. The existing logistics management strategies requires to introduce B2C and B2B into the side of the logistics management.

articleTitle: Research on the cooperation between supply chain enterprises based on game theory
abstract: In 21 century, the market competition tends to compete between supply chain and supply chain. The competitive power of the supply chain comes from the cooperation of supply chain company. This paper made research on the cooperative relationship between supply chain enterprises, analyzed the non-cooperative and cooperative game strategy between supply chain enterprises, compared the cooperation efficiency in both cases. The efficiency of most supply chain is low under non-cooperative strategy, and cooperative game can make the supply chain get greater return in the theory. The conclusion is that long-term cooperation in the supply chain can lead to greater benefits for the supply chain enterprises. Therefore, cooperative game strategy can improve the overall efficiency of the supply chain, and also allows for maximum individual interests. The results make all parties to obtain higher returns, achieve win-win situation.

articleTitle: Study on construction mode and mechanism of rural medical supply chain culture
abstract: In order to improve performance and competitiveness of rural medical supplying chain, this paper analyzes the meaning, strategic position and formation process of rural medical supplying chain culture, and proposes three construction modes of rural medical supplying chain culture including integration mode, interactive mode and isolation mode, and designs values sharing mechanism, culture fusion mechanism, mutual trust mechanism, communication & coordination mechanism and incentive mechanism, which can promote construction of rural medical supplying chain culture. Thus to provide theory method guidance and tactics support for managing rural medical supply chain and the culture.

articleTitle: Research on real estate investment project effect based on game model
abstract: Real estate project investment effect has been a hot topic for developers today. In this paper Cournot Duopoly Model and Stacklberg Model are used to solve and further carry on the analysis about the competition among real estate enterprises, revealed the enterprise respective effect and the overall effect under the same game, the order consecutive game, coalition game and monopolistic game. Then the conclusion is that real estate enterprises alliance and monopoly cooperation may realize the enterprises' long-term development goal and enhance the enterprise's competition capacity, the way of alliance and monopoly in real estate enterprise competition is the future developmental trend. The study provides the theoretical basis for the enterprises to select the appropriate operation structure.

articleTitle: The diagnosis and countermeasures on comprehensive budget management problems of tobacco companies
abstract: The Comprehensive budget management(CBM) can plan long-term strategic business plans, to have the step, by stages concrete application and implementation. China National Tobacco is an important source of tax revenue. The study of CBM of tobacco companies has important practical significance. This paper systematically introduces the implementation of the CBM for the tobacco companies in the management of key issues, to find the root causes of these problems; and indicates that the tobacco companies in the implementation of a CBM must deal with several major relationships, improve budget management from the organization, establish the CBM rules and regulations, build a sound management of the Comprehensive budget process, and make budget management information system to speed up the construction of measures.

articleTitle: An empirical study of the external motivation about R&D outsourcing
abstract: This paper empirically researches on external motivations of R&D outsourcing by multiple regression analysis. The results show that the market environment changes, the attitude of governments and international organizations and relevant policies and economic globalization is respectively positively related with R & D outsourcing, receives strongly support. But the development of information technology positively related with R & D outsourcing has not been strongly supported. The results provide significant implications to management of R & D outsourcing enterprises.

articleTitle: Structural equation modeling for effects of enterprise operation on enterprise value
abstract: The study aims to judge the influencing factors and degrees of enterprise operation on enterprise value. The paper chooses China listed steel companies as the analytical objects and establishes a structural equation model guided by the theory of enterprise value maximization, to explore the effects of operating aspects on three dimensions of enterprise value which are enterprise's interest, stockholder's interest and customer's interest. The results indicate: human and investment are positive to enterprise value; the most significant human capacity is the ability of employee creating profit; the marketing expense and administration expense are the important positive invests and the ratio of operators is a negative factor. Growth and turnover nearly have no effects on enterprise's and customer's interests, but have a certain positive function on stockholder's interest.

articleTitle: Study on the competitive power of residential service industry in Guangdong Province
abstract: The residential service industry is the most closed service sector to people's daily lives. The competitive power of residential service industry directly reflects the comprehensive competitiveness and developmental level of local residential service industry, and it is the main element in measuring the social harmony of a region and people's life and work in peace and contentment. The statistical yearbook data, national economic census data, as well as on-the-spot investigation materials were used to analyze the residential service industry in Guangdong Province, using the competitive power theory to discuss the competitive power of Guangdong residential service industry. Besides this, fuzzy evaluation method was used to evaluate the status of the competitive power of Guangdong residential service industry in 31 provinces (cities, districts) through constructing a multi-level index system. Finally based on the analysis of the competitive power of the residential service industry between twenty-one cities of Guangdong province, it comes to a conclusion that in comparison with the whole country, the competitive power of Guangdong residential service industry is at the forefront of the competitive power of residential service industry.

articleTitle: A study on risks of cross-border merger and acquisition of SOES in China based on PEST model
abstract: Facts show that there are existing great risks in the course of M&A for SOEs, resulting in the low rate of success. In order to analyze the features of M&A conducted by SOEs in China, qualitative research method and inductive research method are applied. What is more, with the aid of the PEST model, some cases concerned, both successful and unsuccessful, are further delved into and many key risk factors in the course of M&A in the area of politics, economy, culture and technology are identified. All these are of great practical significance to the avoidance of decision errors and the further implementation of China's strategy “going global”.

articleTitle: Research on the operation efficiency of major airports in Asia based on the combined evaluation method
abstract: This paper uses the combined evaluation method to evaluate the operation efficiency of major airports in Asia to study the efficiency of airport operations of its content and influencing factors. The paper establishes the evaluation index system to evaluate the efficiency of airport operations, uses the combined weighting method to determine the index weight of all layers and analyzes empirically the operation efficiencies of the major hub airports in Asia in 2007. Results show that in 2007 the rank of Asia's major airport operation efficiencies is as follows: Hong Kong, Narita, Changi, Shenzhen, Incheon, Beijing, Guangzhou and Pudong. The evaluation result can objectively reflect the overall level of the airports' operation efficiencies and thus the evaluation methods are scientific and reasonable.

articleTitle: The influence of international human resource management of Korean multinational corporations in China
abstract: To examine international human resource management (IHRM) configurations and their explanatory variables, this study generated conceptual frameworks and tested them with data collected from Korean multinational corporations (MNCs) in china. To test the hypotheses, data is collected from 319 Chinese and Korean employees of three study Korean MNCs in China. From the data, The study derived three different IHRM configurations:(1) high earnings, working conditions, job security, cooperation and career development influence Chinese employees more than Korean employees; (2) The Korean employees, compared to the Chinese employees, prefer “fortress-style” and “club-style” of corporate cultures; (3) Both the Chinese and the Korean find money to be a working-reward.

articleTitle: A study on agile ordering optimization based on mixed pricing in supply chain cluster
abstract: In this paper, the mixed order pricing strategy presented that can effectively motivate the distributors to increase the order quantity and reduce the times of order, especially the times of small quantity replenishment order on the basis of ensuring the same supply chain cluster agility, are presented. The implementation of the mixed order pricing strategy guarantees the same agility of the SMEs in a supply chain cluster and improve the production initiative of manufacturers. Our conclusions reflect longer production plan can be scheduled; the continuity and stability of production can be improved; and the risk of supply interruption of distributors can be reduced. In general, SMEs agile ordering mechanism in the supply chain cluster has been improved under mixed order pricing strategy.

articleTitle: Virtual teams research in China -Analysis from 2000–2009
abstract: The purpose of this study is to present an in-depth analysis of the current state of the art of virtual teams (VTs) research in the main land of China by systematically reviewing papers published from 2000-2009. A total of 148 papers are identified and classified by their research topics, research methods, and theoretical foundations. Based on examination and analysis of our data, some critical issues for further VTs research in China are pointed out, including promising research areas, theoretical foundation building and empirical methods appropriation. Hopefully, our finding can pave a fruitful way for the Chinese researchers who have interests in VTs in the future.

articleTitle: Committee
abstract: Provides a listing of current committee members.

articleTitle: Contents
abstract: Presents the table of contents of the proceedings.

articleTitle: [Copyright notice]
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: management science and industrial engineering.

articleTitle: Monetary policy under a dynamic Heckscher-Ohlin-Samuelson framework
abstract: This paper shows that current account has the property of mean-reversion and the speed of current account convergence is heterogeneous across countries. In order to explore the factors which affect the current account adjustment speed of a small country, this paper builds up a model to study how current account would be affected by factors such as labor supply and monetary policies. This paper found that labor market rigidity may have a significant effect, but monetary policies only have a small impact on current account adjustment.

articleTitle: Commitment effect on social welfare in monopolist market
abstract: This paper shows the effect of commitment from the monopolist on the social welfare. When monopolists can make commitment about his pattern of innovation, the innovation pace is slower than that where he can only react to consumers' expectations, and the social welfare gets worse. Consider the frequency of introducing new products, contrary to Hoppe & Lee's conclusions, the deterrence for entry could play a positive effect on social welfare.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of ship fins stabilizer with single foil at zero speed
abstract: Ship fins stabilizer is a kind of anti rolling ship technique that could produce lift with initiative swing of fins at zero forward speed, and the lift could counteract the rolling forces of ocean waves. The method that fin stabilizer is used to anti rolling ship is different from the conventional theory of anti rolling ship at zero speed, so it's a kind of new theoretics. In order to study the process of lift generation of fin stabilizer at zero speed, numerical simulation is made by the CFD software for the NJ5 fins stabilizer from Harbin Engineering University. The result shows that the method is powerful. The practical fluid mechanical experiment can be carried through and the control strategy can be researched under the guidance of this method.

articleTitle: Research on the evaluation method of R&D alliance innovation performance
abstract: To solve the obstacle that hinders the development of R&D alliances, using frequency analysis and expert consultancy method, on the basis of balanced score card theory, this paper designs R&D alliance innovation performance evaluation index system which includes 25 index and gives the index normalization method. In addition, combining with the matter-elements-analysis method, the paper designs the concrete evaluation method of R&D alliance innovation performance, and makes simulating calculation. Through calculation, the method can not only evaluate R&D alliance innovation performance scientifically and reasonably, but also identify the key factors that affect innovation performance and provide basis for performance improvement. Therefore, there is important guiding function to enhance R&D alliance innovation performance and of great significance both in theory and practice.

articleTitle: The study of network consumer behavior effected by the information
abstract: By analyzing the online information environment and its impact on online consumer behavior, the paper explores the consumer's information cognize process, analyzes the factors such as perceive risk, value and trust which influence purchasing deciding behavior in e-business. The paper puts forward the conception of information preference and the frame of online consumer behavior based on the information process, brings some recommendations for further research.

articleTitle: Research on spatial distribution characteristics of star-hotels in urban district of Chongqing
abstract: In order to analyze the spatial distribution difference of star-hotels in Chongqing city, 81 star-hotels in six districts of Chongqing city were investigated by using spatial analysis tools Mapinfo7.0 of GIS and method of mathematical physics. The results are as follows: firstly the spatial distribution structure is typical cluster structure with multi-center, and there exist large regional differences in distribution of the number of star-hotels among six districts. Secondly, the rating-scale of star-hotels in Chongqing city is a spindle structure. Thirdly, the spatial concentration degree of star-hotels is very high, and spatial equalization degree is very low. So it can be concluded that the spatial distribution of star-hotels in Chongqing city is mainly influenced by the distribution of business centers and condition of traffic.

articleTitle: Research on automotive component supplier selection process
abstract: With the increasing rate of automotive component outsourcing, automobile manufacturing enterprise was also increasing dependence on component suppliers. Based on the standard for the evaluation of suppliers, the paper establishes supplier selection model in four stages, uses TOPSIS method to determine quality suppliers. By follow-up evaluation, automotive manufacturers timely eliminate and update low-quality suppliers. So the Four-stage supplier selection can become a dynamic cycle and maintain continuity.

articleTitle: Choosing the supplier for emergency supplies based on AHP/linear programming
abstract: This paper investigated the choice of suppliers for emergency supplies. An evaluation index system which is suitable for the choice of suppliers for emergency supplies was constructed according to the characteristics of emergency supplies. Since traditional Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) method does not consider limited resource constraints, this paper proposed that the combination of AHP and linear Programming can be utilized in choosing the appropriate supplier, and to solve the issue of rational distribution of purchases. This study provides a new and effective method for the choice of suppliers for emergency supplies, and assists in the reduction of procurement risk and the improvement in procurement efficiency.

articleTitle: The linkage of real estate market and capital market
abstract: In terms of portfolio theory, this paper develops a model to illustrate the linkage of real estate spatial and capital markets. The theoretical model indicates that the current house price is positively correlated with the current stock price, but the forward house price is negatively associated with the current stock price, and vice versa. The empirical results show that the housing price affects the stock price significantly, but the latter has no effect on the former. The returns of real estate and stock will significantly affect their prices. The forward prices will positively impact the current prices, but the forward real estate prices will negatively affect the current stock price.

articleTitle: Application of IDEF method in hardware-in-the-loop process simulation
abstract: In order to solve the control system designing problem in a complex hardware-in-the-loop simulation, on the basis of analyzing the IDEF model, a new method of the control system analysis was presented. By putting into several levels of control structure, a control system model for the production process can be constituted by using IDEF0*. The method provides analysis of the relationship between control parameters, and the framework and strategy of solving the optimal design and control, and the systematic method of optimal design. With this method, a control system was designed for the hardware-in-the-loop simulation in the distillation process as an example, and the effectiveness of this method was illustrated.

articleTitle: Core talent quality assessment in enterprises based on multiple attribute grey clustering
abstract: Core talent quality assessment in enterprises is very important in keeping core competence for enterprises. By grey system theory, a method based on multiple attribute grey clustering was raised to assess core talent quality in enterprises. The assessment steps of this method were analyzed and an example of this method was given. This method has the advantages of being fit for multiple attribute decision-making of core talent quality assessment in enterprises, making core talent quality assessment in enterprises more flexible and being easy to operate for enterprises to assess core talent quality, so it's a scientific and valid method with broad application prospects for core talent quality assessment in enterprises.

articleTitle: Macroscopic growth process of information systems of enterprises in northeast old industrial base
abstract: This paper develops a general law of the growth process of information systems of enterprises in northeast old industrial base. Based on the classical study of Nolan, the paper collected related history data of information systems construction by means of an investigation of 267 enterprises in northeast old industrial base. Then, according to the growth rate of annual information systems expenditures, the information systems growth process of enterprises in northeast old industrial base is divided into five stages from the late 1970's to present, germination, initiation, diffusion, fast development, and harmonious development. At last the paper analyzes the characteristics of each stage and forecasts the development trend.

articleTitle: Fuzzy synthetic evaluation on knowledge sharing ability in high-tech enterprises based on AHP
abstract: In order to examine the conditions on knowledge sharing ability of high-tech enterprises in China, a fuzzy synthetic evaluation system based on Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) is presented. The extent of knowledge sharing depended on the characteristics of knowledge sharing individuals and environment of the organization. Thus the appraisal index system was developed including features of supplier and recipient, characteristics of human resource management in the organization and technical support procedure of knowledge sharing. Then a fuzzy synthetic evaluation on knowledge sharing ability was provided. To evaluate the effectiveness of the model, questionnaires were distributed to a typical high-tech enterprise and interviews were conducted with either the CEOs or senior managers. The information was compared after questionnaires and interviews. The evaluation result indicates that the knowledge sharing ability is in the moderate level and needs further improvement.

articleTitle: The bubble expansion rate of each period of China's fictitious economy development
abstract: Over-development of fictitious economy may produce bubble capital and bubble burst can induce financial crisis. The Granger cause of the representative variable of real economy to the variables of fictitious economy in China is tested and the bubble expansion rate of each period of China's fictitious economy is calculated by the quarterly data from the second quarter of 1998 to the forth quarter of 2009. The results show that there is either unilateral or bidirectional Granger cause among the variables; China's fictitious economy has a low bubble expansion rate from 2008 to 2009; and the expansion rate of the financial market and the futures market increased quickly since 2008. The national sectors of China should take proper measures to promote healthy development of the fictitious economy and improve balanced development of the fictitious economy and real economy.

articleTitle: The application of Markov model in the enterprise personnel planning
abstract: Providing enterprise human resources prediction is very important on enterprise human resource management. Human resources prediction can guarantee that the manpower needs enterprise development. How to correctly predict the enterprise manpower needs become an important issue on enterprise development. This paper established a human resource supply forecasting which used Markov transfer matrix method to forecast the supply of human resources, and study company human resource demand situation in the next three years and make the right demand forecasting. Through Markov model on human resources supply forecasting, the paper proves Markov model can effectively predict future manpower needs.

articleTitle: An empirical research on management control systems model
abstract: This paper attempts to classify the management control systems (MCS) model. By using a native instrument whose reliability and validity are tested empirically, the findings indicate that MCS include objective controls, action controls, outcome controls and cultural controls. This study provides a new theoretical basis for MCS to make adjustment to the new environment.

articleTitle: Research and realization of spectrum sensing for cognitive radio
abstract: Spectrum sensing is one of core technologies in cognitive radio. It can adapt to complicated electric-magnetic environments. By detecting environments in real time and extracting interference characteristic in frequency spectrum, it can use flexible spectrum assign strategy for adaptive communications. Spectrum sensing technology is discussed in this article. Then the realization scheme is proposed and applied in frequency-hopping communication systems. Computer simulations show that it can exactly provide spectrum occupation in real time for frequency-hopping communication systems.

articleTitle: The regression analysis and prediction of Real estate added value based on genetic algorithm
abstract: Total productive value of Real estate is a crucial part of the Service Industry, which directly affects the value of GDP. It is significant to predict the added value of the total productive value of Real estate, by historical observed data and dynamic regression equations. Compare dynamic regression equations with genetic algorithm to regression equation from exponential regression and linear regression. The predicted results through genetic algorithm method get closer to the true value than the other two methods. Meanwhile, the result also points out the added value of the total productive value of Real estate with genetic algorithms in the next years.

articleTitle: The empirical research on affecting factors of automobile industrial cluster
abstract: This paper researches on the Jilin and Shanghai automobile industrial cluster by using the Diamond model and regression analysis. This paper can draw a conclusion that the measures such as improving the production concentration ratio of automobile industry, perfecting the related and supporting industry can improve the development of the automobile industrial cluster.

articleTitle: Study on the hub airport Competence evaluation
abstract: Scientific evaluation of the hub airport Competence is the important prerequisite and basis of enhancing the Competence of the hub airports. The paper first clearly defines and analyzes the conception and characteristics of the hub airports. Based on the critical success factors of the hub airports, the paper builds a hub airport Competence evaluation index system and establishes a multiple criteria decision making model as the evaluation approach. Finally, the paper selects four Chinese hub airports and five foreign hub airports which are of competitive relationship to conduct an empirical analysis.

articleTitle: Impact of human resource management practices on operational performance in manufacturing companies
abstract: This paper takes an empirical research into the correlation between human resource management (HRM) practices and manufacturing performance in manufacturing companies in the world providing the universalistic perspective for practitioner and the academia as well. The empirical analysis is based on the data from the 2009 International Manufacturing Strategy Survey (IMSS), and factor analysis is to classify the 20 items of manufacturing performance and canonical correlation analysis to search for the relationship between HRM practices and manufacturing performance. In the end, the paper finds that some HRM practices are correlated with manufacturing performance, while some are not. Meanwhile, the paper analyzes the possible reasons of the result.

articleTitle: Research on the evaluation system of educational administrator's qualities in colleges based on AHP
abstract: To appraise the qualities of educational administrators scientifically on basis of analytic hierarchy process, the evaluation index must adhere to the principles of scientificity, combined qualitative and quantitative, comprehensiveness and feasibility. The process of the questionnaire data illustrates that among the five aspects of ideology, professional ethics, competence, vocational work and mentality, the weight of competence is the largest, followed by vocational work. The two factors are of great significance in the qualities of educational administrators.

articleTitle: Study on risk evaluation of advanced manufacturing technology based on entropy
abstract: This paper constructs the risk assessment index system of the advanced manufacturing technology based on three dimensions of its strategic adaption, the risk level and the efficiency consideration. It further analyzes the technical realization, the Risk Guarantees and the Maximum Profits Risk of the advanced manufacturing technology with the application of the entropy measurement methods and the calculating formulas of the risk assessment is given to help enterprises to carry out the risk assessment of the advanced manufacturing technology.

articleTitle: Inventory decision for stock-level-dependent demand items with and without VMI
abstract: Researches on vendor-managed inventory (VMI) system rarely consider the relationships between demand rate and inventory level. This paper extended the previous research by considering the effects of stock-level-dependent demand on the benefits of VMI system. Models for items with stock-level-dependent demand were developed to compare the performance of a series supply chain system with and without VMI. Performance measures used in the analysis included the order size placed on the supplier per replenishment, the average net profit and replenishment cycle time. The simulation results show that the implementation of VMI will lead to a less frequent replenishment and more stable order lot size, also show that the VMI implementation will harm the average net profit of retailer, which is different from many of the previous conclusions on VMI system with classical demand pattern. This phenomenon is especially obvious when the market demand is more elastic or the coefficient of inventory level elasticity is larger.

articleTitle: Game of government and forestry enterprise in the management innovation
abstract: Innovation by forestry enterprise is very important to promote forestry enterprise's competition ability and economic development of state-owned forest. In this paper, evolutional game theory was used to construct the game model and study the behaviors of government and forestry enterprise regarding the innovation. Moreover, the strategy interaction and equilibrium between government and forestry enterprise were analyzed. This paper emphasizes the effect of impetus cost of government on the innovation behavior of forestry enterprise. The evolutionary equilibrium of game is that government reduces the outside cost from system so as to promote forestry enterprise to perform innovation, and government and forestry enterprise gain the innovative profits by continuously taking innovation.

articleTitle: The evaluation of college student management and software design
abstract: To increase the quality of college student's work, every college does the job evaluation on student's work performance. In this way to get the ranking of the departments. The existing evaluate fine print is very trivial, the data needed is vast and the evaluated method is much subjective. This paper applies factor analysis method which can find the main factors that influence the achievement of student's work from a great deal of data. The factor model can be built through the scores of items of every department. Thus to simplify the evaluate system. The component score can do monomial or multinomial comprehensive evaluation, so as to make the result much more objective and to reflect the college student's management grade in an-all-round way. The last part gives the design idea and method of evaluated software.

articleTitle: Sonochemical preparation and characterization of MoO3 and MoS2 nanoparticles
abstract: The effect of ultrasound irradiation on MoO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> and MoS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> nanoparticles is investigated. Under ultrasonic irradiation, spherical-like MoO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> nanoparticles are obtained, while bulk-like MoO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> nanoparticles were prepared without ultrasonic irradiation.
