articleTitle: Study on technological innovation ability of China telecommunication equipment manufacture industry
abstract: Technological innovation is the key point for the enterprise to improve its competitive power. As the high-tech industry, telecommunication equipment manufacture industry has the important influence on China. Taking the corporations such as Zhongxing Telecom, Datang Telecom, Fenghuo Telecom, Hengtong electronic and Fangu telecom into consideration, the differences of R&D expenditure and staff management showed the way to improve technological innovation ability. By comparing and analyzing the differences, the detail countermeasures have been put forwarded.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of the coal production logistics system on balance improved
abstract: In coal mine production, according to the requirement on balance between production and transport of the system, the establishment of coal bunker was taken as an important method to solve this problem. Based on the producing layout underground and utilizing the theory of reliability analysis, the reliability model of the system was built, and the reliability calculation formula of the coal bunker was obtained. The reliability states of coal bunker were given and transfer each other, and the failure and availability were gained. By comparing to the availability of coal bunker in different states, the results show that the establishment of coal bunker will effectively enhance the reliability and improve the balance in production logistics system. The efficiency of the entire coal production makes sense, and improving the availability of the coal bunker is an important way to the production logistics system.

articleTitle: Establishment of national industrial safety evaluation index system under the influence of the Cross-border M&A based on DEA
abstract: Although Cross-border Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) introduced effective foreign capital, insecurity also brought to the industries in our country. The establishment of the evaluation index system becomes a major key by using Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) method to evaluate the national industrial security under the influence of the Cross-border M&A. On this basis, this paper has explained and built the national industrial security evaluation index system under the influence of Cross-border M&A based on DEA. So industrial security can be evaluated from different aspects.

articleTitle: Research on Innovation Relay Centre structure model of risk factors
abstract: Innovation Relay Centre(IRC) is a successful technology transfer network for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). IRC shows many brand-new characteristics of intermediary transfer organizations, and simultaneously increases many new risks. From the view of risk management, the paper comprehensively analyzed the risk factors which affected the IRC operation through factor analysis technology, and obtained environmental risk, technology risk, management risk, financial risk and project selection risk. In order to further confirm the relationship between IRC risk factors and IRC performance factors, the study carried on the regression analysis between the five dimensions and the IRC performance factors. This paper finally summarized the risk factors' influence to IRC, and provided a theoretical guidance to prevent and control the IRC risks.

articleTitle: Research on parts processing based on virtual technique
abstract: To meet the best equipment running state, through characterization of gear parts processing based on virtual technique, functional modules in each working procedure were established. On the basis of product modeling, technical process modeling and production tools modeling, the monitoring and the operation of the whole process systems and production process could be realized and the information descriptions of the three-dimensional model and surface model could be completed. And a variety of processing methods could be chosen according to the different accuracy requirements of parts in process. Clamping method, position baseline could be determined simultaneously to meet the best equipment running state and the high efficient choice of tools, fixtures, and measuring tool. Finally concludes that characterized information model can greatly enhance production performance and further drive production flow into standardization and rationalization.

articleTitle: Robust single echelon multi period inventory of Eco-industrial Symbiotic Network with uncertain returns and demand
abstract: In recent years, robust optimization has become a powerful tool in dealing with the uncertainty optimization problems. And it has been widely applied in many fields successfully. The cost issue in the Eco-industrial Symbiotic Network (EISN) is the main factor that limits its survival and development. Under certain government incentives and considering that the returns and demands in EISN are uncertain, this paper made research on the Inventory control problem of EISN. A non-linear robust optimization model of minimizing the overall cost of EISN is proposed and then it is transferred into a linear model. Its solution is proved to exist. Therefore, the minimum overall cost of EISN is obtained.

articleTitle: Value at risk calculations: An empirical analysis for stock market in China
abstract: This paper applies the extreme value theory on Value-at-Risk (VaR) calculation, which focuses on modeling the tails of the return distribution rather than the whole distribution. Extreme value theory has more meaning during the volatile market conditions, under which the distribution of returns almost has a fat tail. Because of its biggest advantage of comprehensive, VaR calculation has become the mainstream method of measuring risk. This paper deals with the behavior of the tails of financial series. More specifically, the focus is the use of extreme value theory to assess tail related risk. The application of extreme value theory is illustrated by an example from the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock market data. The paper concludes that the both distributions are fat tails and the limit distribution for centralized and normalized maxima is a Frechet type. So the extreme value theory is properly applied and it's a useful complement to traditional VaR methods.

articleTitle: The influence factors of rural land circulation based on farm households subtitle as needed
abstract: In order to analyze the influence factors of rural land circulation, based on theory analysis and empirical study, the results indicate that the farm households' behaviors result from kinds of factors. Contract land per person, non-agricultural income per person, agricultural members per family and the high school education are four main influence factors. According to the results, the paper gave some suggestions to improve rural land circulation.

articleTitle: Game analysis on agricultural biomass supplementary collection strategies for industrial buyers in local markets
abstract: This paper reveals the mechanism of supplementary collection strategy for industrial buyers in a local supply market. A framework is presented to describe the economic behaviors, goals and interests of players in the market. Game theory is applied to investigate the willingness of suppliers and industrial buyers to seek strategies that promote the common interests; supplementary collection strategy is specially focused on sustainable biomass supply. The conclusion is that industrial buyers who adopt supplementary collection strategy will get more profits, but the supplementary collection strategy is lowly efficient in biomass utilization for the decision makers.

articleTitle: Empirical study of human resource management in China's shipbuilding enterprises based on social network analysis
abstract: To solve the poor efficiency and working activity problem of shipbuilding industry in China, the paper used MDS to analyze HRM Department, built 2 - model network to analyze the relationship of different departments in China's shipbuilding enterprises. The paper got the initial data of “Point” and “relationship” of the initial phase and the operational phase. The biggest problem is to rarely manage and control the whole enterprise with abroad advanced shipbuilding experience. At last the paper gave suggestions to the problem. HRM Departments in China's shipbuilding enterprises should transfer the employee training to the “idle period” with no shipbuilding projects, so that employees' work can remain high level.

articleTitle: A model of self-selected governance on commons
abstract: The governance of Commons (i.e. Common-Pool Resources, or CPRs) is an intractable problem in our society. It's a fundamental task to govern the CPRs problems entirely by self-selected governance arrangement. Using the approaches of game theory, mathematical modeling, design a self-selected governance mechanism on commons, which well solves the problems such as incentives, supervising, enforcement, information, transaction cost and etc. As a result, this governance mechanism guarantees the sustainable and effective governance of commons under a set of conditions being satisfied. The conclusion is self-selected governance arrangement is superior than government regulation, private property rights governance and self-organized & self-governed arrangements, and successfully solve the problem of free ride to CPRs units, which entirely resolve the problem of insufficient supply of commons in the long run.

articleTitle: Study development of logistics industry in Heilongjiang Province
abstract: The paper focuses on the relationship between economic integration in Northeast Asia and the development of Heilongjiang Province based on economic environment in Northeast Asia. To develop logistics industry in Heilongjiang Province, the paper proposes measures that can enhance the level of development in accordance with the development of logistics industry in Heilongjiang Province.

articleTitle: Research on the regional development advantage of green food industry in Heilongjiang province
abstract: The theoretical and approach research on the advantage of industry regional development is beneficial to the detection of the origin and factors that affect competitive advantage of green food industry in Heilongjiang province. The analysis is made on the comparative advantage and competitive advantage by means of local quotient index. The study shows that the overall growing trend of green food industry in Heilongjiang province is likely to increase fluctuate, which belongs to the advantageous region of green food industry in China, the competitive advantage is more obvious after 2001. It is essential to combine market adjustment with systematic advantage, to combine the construction of green food base and the cultivation, support of big corporation groups, and to combine cooperation with competition, then the win-win, multi-wining developing framework will finally come into being.

articleTitle: Study on talents training pattern based on concurrent engineering theory
abstract: High education plays a major mission of a large number of creative talents. However, lack of innovation and practice ability are very prominent. The current situation of high education is analyzed, and the existing problems are summarized including educational idea, teaching system and course system. By applying concurrent engineering theory, reconstruction model of education engineering was established. The integration of education and employment process was achieved. On the base of these, the new idea of high education was proposed, and project-driven education mode was established from a theoretical perspective. Finally, some relevant suggestions were made.

articleTitle: The impact of knowledge economy on the enterprise investment innovation
abstract: In the knowledge economy era, as an important part of business financial management, investment management is influenced by the knowledge economy. Investment innovation is concerned with academic and practice of the profession. This paper not only affirms the significance of investment innovation for businesses to develop, but also discusses the key problems about business investment innovation through analyzing the effects of the knowledge economy on enterprises investment innovation. The paper suggests that enterprises should focus on human resources management, information technology, innovation management and new product development in the knowledge economy.

articleTitle: Brand marketing management in China cigarette enterprises
abstract: With the competition environment of economic globalization and market internationalization, this paper systematically analyzes some important points of brand and competitiveness, attempts to generalize the main sources of cigarette brand competitiveness from both intrinsic and extrinsic aspects. At the initial phase of brand development, cigarette brand image and impression are of great importance, so as to intensify the awareness and recognition of potential cigarette customers. Then, cigarette enterprises must focus on brand relations and loyalty. At the end of product life cycle, the restoration of cigarette brand value cannot be over stressed to retain consumers. The conclusion indicates major brand factors must be constantly stressed to achieve cigarette brand competitiveness, and then generate marketing strategies for the prospective cigarette markets.

articleTitle: Potential evaluation of tourism development based on multi-level grey theory
abstract: As the capacity of tourism resources to develop tourism industry and to gain economic, social and environmental benefits, the potential of tourism development is the application prospect of tourism development conditions, evaluation of which can help tourism managers to make reasonable decision of tourism development. Multi-level grey approach is the combination of the analytic hierarchy process and the grey system theory, which is applied to carry on researches with quite small sample and poor information. In this work, multi-level grey approach is applied to evaluate the development potential of Langshan Danxia scenic area, and the result indicates that it belongs to more-high scope. So the conclusion is that high-grade tourist resources are not equal to the good development potential. To strengthen the tourism development potential of Langshan Danxia scenic area, the tourism managers should not only develop the new product and new product function, but also develop the new tourist market unceasingly.

articleTitle: An analysis of the relationship between river port logistics and urban economic growth
abstract: Based on the statistics data of cargo throughput and GDP of Nanjing from 1978 to 2009, this paper analyzes the relationship between river port logistics and urban economic growth by employing co-integration theory and Granger causality test. The empirical result denotes that there exists a long-term equilibrium relationship and unilateral Granger causality relationship between river port logistics and urban economic growth. Urban economic growth has positive effect on river port logistics, whereas river port logistics has no significant effect on urban economic growth.

articleTitle: The nature of managerial ties in China
abstract: Previous research documented the value of managerial ties in emerging economies such as China. Integrating institutional theory and social capital view, the paper developed a matrix to analyze the nature of ties, and emphasized the distinctive economic and institutional attributes of ties with a dialectical perspective. Using data from 270 firms in Chinese manufacturing industry, the paper demonstrated the different effects of ties on performance. Besides, the paper explored the role of ownership (domestic vs. foreign) and environment dynamism. The results support the view that institutional and environment factors influence the value of ties.

articleTitle: Low carbon development assessment of Fujian Province, China based on fuzzy analytic hierarchy process (FAHP) and forest carbon sinks information
abstract: The low carbon development assessment can provide valid information to support decision making in regional sustainable development. With the support of forest carbon sinks information simulated from remote sensing data, the low carbon development assessment index framework of Fujian Province, China was constructed. After indices weighting by the fuzzy analytic hierarchy process (FAHP), the low carbon development of Fujian in 2005 was assessed. The assessment result indicates that low carbon development index (LCD) of county or city in Fujian Province, China has relatively high correlation with the percentage of tertiary industry and per capita forest net primary productivity (NPP). So development tertiary industry and improvement forest carbon carrying capacity are important approaches for low carbon development in Fujian presently.

articleTitle: Research on the dynamic regional innovation output elasticity in China based on the data of patent applications
abstract: According to the unbalanced regional economic development in China, this paper applied dynamic econometrics to research on the innovation output elasticity of each region. Select patent applications and GDP as the index of innovation output and economic growth, and there exists dynamic relationship between them. Based on the model of Polynomial Distributed Lags (PDLs), the results show that, in china innovation had a significant role in promoting economic growth, and the driving force reached peak in middle term. The total innovation output elasticity is different among eastern, middle and western region. Also there exists great innovation potential in western region, the government should give more support to western region.

articleTitle: Lending relationship analysis of micro-loan company on game theory
abstract: Soft information is the basis of decision-making and loan pricing in relationship banking. Being a new type of commercial microfinance organization in China's rural financial market, the lending technology of micro-loan company is relationship banking, loans credited to clients based on soft information collected by loan officers. For the sustainable development of micro-loan company, The paper examined the lending relationship of micro-loan company with perfect and imperfect information on game theory. The results show that the key factor for micro-loan company to avoid trapping into prisoner's dilemma and loan losses is the sufficiency and accuracy of acquired soft information. Establishing long-term and exclusive relationship with loan clients within a certain time is the only way for micro-loan company to obtain soft information indeed.

articleTitle: Research on supply chain inventory of agricultural products
abstract: In view of the system dynamics, a three-lever supply chain of agricultural products was established and analyzed, in which the supermarket is in the core place. Considering the impacts of Bullwhip Effect and inventory variation, a supermarket-leading inventory model of three-lever supply chain was constructed, the cause-and-effect figure and the flow graph were proposed. The result of simulation shows that the new model was more visible and the inventory remains lower level than before, and when the supermarket was in the core place, all the parts in supply chain could link up greatly. Thus system dynamics brings an available principle and method to research the complicated and dynamics agriculture supply chain.

articleTitle: Research on logistics distribution routing problem based on GIS
abstract: Due to the deficiency of logistics distribution, this paper presents a new approach to deal with VRP problems and utilizes network analysis function of GIS. Firstly, this paper specifies how to establish road network based on GIS. Secondly, this paper focuses on Vehicle Routing Problems with Time Window constraints. Finally, article based on the network analysis function of GIS, routing results on map can display according to actual condition of road network.

articleTitle: Research on power eeterprise' financial risk appraisal based on fuzzy mathematics
abstract: Financial risk is the most significant and comprehensive reflection form of the business risk. How to utilize these fuzziness financial targets to the financial risk's appraisal, becomes now the key point on financial risk appraisal. In the foundation of analyzing the origin of thermoelectricity generation business finance risk, this paper establishes thermoelectricity generation business finance risk assessment model based on the fuzzy mathematics, and carries on the confirmation using the data of Datang International Power Generation Co., Ltd. Through analytical study, based on fuzzy mathematics' financial risk evaluation model, the paper proves the feasibility that in our country thermal power enterprise finance risk assessment and the management, provides the help in enhancing the enterprise core competitiveness for our country thermal power enterprise under the electric power organizational reform's background.

articleTitle: A study on the perfection of government-led financial supervision system in China in times of financial crisis
abstract: Operating mechanism of finance supervision institution and financial ecology in economic reality should be suitable. That is a key factor to influence the supervisory performance of financial supervision institution. By means of comparative analysis, functional analysis, economic analysis and historical analysis, this paper analyzed risks of financial mixed operation and disarrangement of finance supervision institution in China. Since operating mechanism of finance supervision institution and financial ecology were unsuitable, the supervisory performance of finance supervision institution in China was low. In order to safeguard financial stability and promote economic growth, it is an inevitable choice for China to build the government-led financial supervision system with the People's Bank of China as the core. It is also beneficial to accomplish the effective supervision of main systematic risks and improve the performance of financial supervision institution.

articleTitle: An empirical research on distribution of cash dividends — Based on the data after the completion of split-share structure reform
abstract: Based on the listed companies that have completed the split-share structure reform, attempting to examine the relationship between consideration and cash dividends, this paper established four hypothesizes and used ordinary multiple regression methods. The empirical results show that the relationship between the two aspects has a negatively correlated relationship. The higher the consideration, the lower cash dividends after the split-share structure reform, whether the enterprises are state-owned or non-state-owned. But the cash dividends are apparently different between state-owned and non-state-owned. The results also reflect a fact that after the completion of the split-share structure reform, the interests of two kinds of shareholders are becoming more and more consistent. So the split-share structure reform can be regarded as successful.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of coal supply chain based on fuzzy matter-element model
abstract: In order to achieve the coordination and balance development of the coal supply chain, this paper designed a performance evaluation model of coal supply chain, using Balanced score-card and the Supply chain operation standard model. Six coal supply chains' performance was evaluated by Analytic Hierarchy Process and Entropy method. The results show that the development of coal supply chains in our country is in an early-stage; the performance of the coal supply chain which core business is circulation enterprises are superior to which core business is production enterprise. Some measures are suggested for coal supply chain to improve coal supply chain performance.

articleTitle: An empirical analysis on energy consumption and economic growth in Henan Province
abstract: Using the methods of co-integration analysis and Granger causality test, this paper researches on the relationship between Henan's GDP and energy consumption based on the data of 1980–2008. The empirical results show that there is a stable equilibrium relation between Henan's energy consumption and economic growth in the long run. The results also show that there is one-orientated causality from economic growth to energy consumption.

articleTitle: A research on consumers' adopting motives of e-commerce
abstract: Aiming at better understanding the functioning mechanism of factors affecting consumers to adopt e-commerce, the paper adopted empirical methods such as questionnaire investigation, regression analysis, and cluster analysis, provided a quantitative analysis. Based on an analysis of the overall data, the degree of affecting on adopting motives was obtained. Consequently, firms can make effective decisions and formulate long-term strategies on e-commerce.

articleTitle: Research of higher education input-output efficiency based on principal component analysis
abstract: A mathematical model was built to make analysis on higher education input-output efficiency. The model included eight input indicators and six output indicators of 31 areas in China. The principal component analysis method was used to reduce dimension of input indicators and output indicators. The multidimensional variables were simplified to one input principal component and one output principal component, which then were used to compare and analyze input-output efficiency of 31 areas. As a result, higher input usually leads to higher output but doesn't lead to higher input-output efficiency. Effective operational mechanisms should be set up to ensure the close connection between input and output, and to improve input-output efficiency.

articleTitle: Campus network-based non-contact IC card room management system design
abstract: With the growth of the number of computer applications, all colleges and universities are bound to build their own computer rooms. There are many problems in previous room management means. This paper built a B / S structure-based IC card room management system utilizing the existing university campus network infrastructures and through network data transmission, which can uniformly manage all the rooms in university by the central control unit, saving time and effort, and easy to co-ordinate arrangements. Meanwhile, in consideration of the disadvantages to easily wear and lose data of the traditional IC card, this system used the non-contact IC card.

articleTitle: Research on coordination of electronic products supply chain based on information sharing
abstract: Based on the supply chain information sharing, the study focused on the inventory problem of members in the electronics supply chain. Nowadays, most studies are based on the upstream and downstream supply chain coordination of information sharing between enterprises. This paper studied the influence of information sharing among members of same level in supply chain on the inventory policy. Considering the cost factors caused by information sharing, this paper established a model consisting of two of the same level retailers in the electronic products supply chain. And the relationship between cost and transfer payments of share information was obtained.

articleTitle: Index to authors
abstract: The author index contains an entry for each author and coauthor included in the proceedings record.

articleTitle: Organization member marginalized in the environmental construction based on trust
abstract: To accelerate the development of an organization and make the system and environment more harmonious, the paper analyzes the characteristics and performance of marginalization, specifies the corresponding inducing reasons. So the corresponding measurement system is constructed, and the main effect factors are found. It's concluded that the effective strategies should be described as: to abstract the core values of win-win cooperation, strengthen and improve leadership, strengthen the cultivation and management of career planning, improve innovation mechanism and strengthen personal cultivation, and create a harmonious external environment.

articleTitle: Application of real option approach to investment decision-making of building projects
abstract: The research is to help building enterprise make plan and manage their strategy investment. Real option, as a new theoretical approach, is broadly applied in investment decision, finance management etc. In this paper the application of real options in building projects investment is discussed based on binomial tree model and B-S model which can improve the defect of traditional methods and make building projects investment become more reasonable.

articleTitle: Study on flexible degree evaluation of logistics system based on evidence theory
abstract: There are many uncertainties during logistics operation. It's the best way for coping with influences of uncertainties and increasing the efficiency and effect of logistics system to maintain proper flexibility. Evaluation on flexibility of logistics system is precondition and key for building and holding the flexibility of logistics system. In this paper, the flexible indexes of three stages including planning, implementing and controlling in logistics system are analyzed. Then the evaluation method of flexible degree is presented and the validity of the method is proved by examples.

articleTitle: The new points about Human Resource management strategy on Corporate social responsibility
abstract: There is a demand in modern society, for each enterprise to hold social responsibility. That is, with no social responsibility an enterprise couldn't be viable. For that, it's necessary for each employee to have social responsibility, and for an enterprise to manage their pupils based on the social responsibility. This paper identifies the corporate social responsibility on the basis of the theory of the profit-related parties, and analyzes the relationship between the CSR (Corporate social responsibility) and HRM (Human Resource management). Then, this paper claims HRM strategy in the building of CSR, which includes three parts: to rebuild modern human resource awareness, to reinforce CSR awareness, and to bring new ideas of the management mode.

articleTitle: Research on evaluation index system of regional innovation
abstract: The evaluation of regional innovation system is the important premise to enhance innovation capability, and it's necessary to build a reasonable and scientifically evaluation index system for evaluating a regions' economic development. According to the index system, the statistic data of 2008 and factor analysis method are applied in this paper to evaluate the innovation capability of Heilongjiang Province empirically, and the conclusion can be drawn that: innovation policy and environment have made greater contribution to regional innovation system, and the consciousness and behavior of innovation subject takes the second place. Therefore, people should strictly take some measures such as improving the environment for innovation, strengthening the policy guidance and support for regional innovation subject and so on to enhance regional innovation capability.

articleTitle: Research on enterprise knowledge transfer model and performance evaluation based on knowledge value chain
abstract: Knowledge value chain is important for the enterprise to promote knowledge transfer. Knowledge transfer is a key link in the process of enterprise knowledge management, whose purpose is to absorb and make full use of new knowledge, and through which knowledge helpful to the enterprise is put into application to gain the competitive. The function and the dual path of knowledge value chain are analyzed, the knowledge transfer model is established based on knowledge value chain, and the performance formation and composition is interpreted in the process of knowledge transfer. Based on these mentioned above, the index system of performance evaluation of knowledge transfer is designed, the method of ELECTRE I is selected to evaluate knowledge transfer performance, and the numerical example is conducted. Therefore, the performance evaluation model, index, and method of enterprise knowledge transfer are verified scientifically.

articleTitle: Empirical research on the relationship between interfirm knowledge transfer and alliance performance
abstract: With the economic globalization and rapid development of high-tech, knowledge transfer as the controllable resource and decisive factor of sustainable competitive advantage in strategic alliance, has a positive impact on the improvement of alliance performance. In this paper, With an empirical investigation of 203 enterprises' sample in China, several research hypotheses are tested. The result shows that interfirm knowledge transfer has a positive impact on alliance performance. Interfirm knowledge transfer plays a significant positive impact on alliance performance mainly through the dimensions of comprehension and economy, but the speed of knowledge transfer does not have positive effects on alliance performance. Then, this paper gives some theoretical deductions and interpretations with the combination of market features and alliance features of China. The conclusions have a certain value for the further research and business management practices.

articleTitle: Study on the market competitive state of Guangdong international inbound tourism from 1999 to 2008
abstract: The number of inbound visitors and its growth rate of inbound tourism are key indicators in reflecting international tourism development levels of a country or a region. BCG Matrix model was used to analyze Guangdong international inbound tourism market during the process of research, selecting market share rate and market growth rate to build tourism market competitive state, besides, it analyzes the market share rate and the market growth rate of Guangdong main inbound tourist source markets in Guangdong international tourism from 1999 to 2008, and it shows the changing situation of the number of Guangdong foreign tourists. Finally, the relative market development strategies are put forward on the basis of the above research.

articleTitle: Study on the optimal ordering strategy of Short Lifecycle Products based on stochastic demand
abstract: For the characteristic of short storage life and quick value decay for Short Lifecycle Products (SLPs), it is supposed that suppliers provide Quantity Discount Pricing (QDP), lead time and demand rate comply with stochastic normal distributions, and stock-outs are permitted. And the optimal ordering models of SLPs were developed for discrete and continuous stochastic demand. Then the arguments analysis received the important reference results. In addition the algorithm procedure and numerical value example were provided to figure out the optimal order quantity and safe stock.

articleTitle: The study of supplier selection of vegetable supply chain in Hebei Province
abstract: Purpose of this paper is that the choice of vegetable suppliers provides a strong guarantee for the vegetable supply chain to effectively avoid risks and enhance core competencies in Hebei Province. From four types of the vegetable suppliers and five indicators, the article uses the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) to compare their advantages and disadvantages. The results show that the Agricultural Association is the best suppliers on the vegetable supply chain. This finding can strengthen the construction of vegetable supply chain and improve the vegetables competition in the market.

articleTitle: Risk analysis of the third-party payment business
abstract: Assessing the third-party payment risk is to use scientific methods and forecast risk, which could provide executive scientific basis. Qualitative analysis and quantified analysis are dialectical and unified. To analyze the third-party payment risk assessment with the methods of AHP and vague general evaluation model, the third-party payment business is showed as an example for research. The conclusions are that development of third-party payment is not ripe and has more risks in use, the legal risks and financial risks are especially serious. Government needs to encourage and support development of the third-party payment and develop appropriate measures in their supervision. The payment enterprise must improve their competitiveness and establish credibility system. The bank must examine strictly the qualifications and specific information of the third-party payment platform. The consumer must choose payment business reasonably and strengthen their sense of security payment. It proved practicability of the conclusions from the numerical analysis.

articleTitle: Purchase cost control research based on centralized procurement model
abstract: Procurement is the starting point of business activity which is the key to the cost of production. More and more modern enterprises use a centralized procurement, but there are still some problems. This paper established a centralized purchasing model and analysis of specific issues. The establishment of the centralized procurement model is improved to further reduce the cost of centralized purchasing. Therefore to reduce the cost of centralized purchasing.

articleTitle: An analysis on the Symbiosis capability of sports industry in Ningbo
abstract: Based on symbiosis theory and symbiotic model, and with layout and development of sports industry, Ningbo City, as a research object, this paper tries to measure the degree of the influence of sports industry and the interaction by symbiotic degree and Symbiosis coefficient. The paper can conclude that Sports Services is the most competitive industry which should be the key industry to develop and to promote the development of other types of sports industry. Because the handy data is sparse, the paper hopes to do further research, such as data gathering, analysis and distribution, giving the city a sense of direction in the sports industry.

articleTitle: Operational capability evaluation of Engineering Regiment based on matter element model
abstract: As a comprehensive system, operational capability of Engineering Regiment is very complex to evaluate. Principles to determine the index system is presented by analyzing a variety of technical factors and uncertainties. According to the principle of “task center and systemic argumentation”, the index system of operational capability evaluation of Engineering Regiment is established which consists of more than 20 categories of indexes. A matter element model of the level evaluation to assess the operational capability of Engineering Regiment is built up by combining quantitative analysis with qualitative analysis. The multi-ingredient fighting efficiency assessment is transformed into the single-object decision and the evaluation values can directly show the integrative level of the operational capability of Engineering Regiment. The application result shows that it's simple and practical.

articleTitle: Intra-county economic improvement in China: Perspective and strategies
abstract: In order to provide some new development ideas for intra-county economy in different levels of China, the development experiences of intra-county from the developed countries can be referred according to the development characteristics of intra-county economy in China. Then the ideas and countermeasures are drawn by using these experiences. Finally, the effectiveness of the countermeasures can be verified by empirical analysis.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation for private colleges and universities based on the balanced scorecard
abstract: Private colleges and universities have developed widely. Scientific performance evaluation for private colleges and universities benefits to strengthen the school management. Based on the performance management theory and real situation of private colleges and universities, a performance evaluation index system is established based on the balanced scorecard. The system is then assessed using the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method. The practices have proved the feasibility and capability of implement of this system which has important theoretical guiding significance for strategic development of private colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Research on uncertainty demand inventory control in supply chain
abstract: The overall operations of supply chain are affected by the increase of demand uncertainty. Inventory control is an important part in supply chain management. Under the requirement mentioned above, this paper studies the inventory control with uncertainty demand. Three-echelon inventory model of manufacture regarded as core enterprise is modeled, which assumes that uncertainty demand subjects to normal distribution. Redundancy inventory in the node enterprise of supply chain is discussed under the two inventory replenishment strategy (continuous review inventory and periodic review inventory). It 's shown that the result of this study is valuable to reduce the total cost of inventory and improve the performance of supply chain.

articleTitle: The study of the functional isomorphism model of agricultural cooperation economic organization on the base of the living system theory
abstract: This paper uses the living systems theory to view the agricultural cooperation economic organizations as one form in the human life system evolution, comparing live characteristics of constitution of open system, maintaining the internal environment stability, self-regulation and self-renewal, conducting qualitative, quantitative and semi-quantitative standard research on the agricultural cooperation organizations. This paper analyzes the relationship between the agricultural cooperation organizations and social environment system which has six sub-systems. The study also maps the agricultural cooperation organizations to the currency space, builds a “function isomorphism” model, constructs financial balance equations, calculates the four indicators measuring and simulates the actual operation of agricultural cooperative organization, refines a universal organization law through repeated optimization, which is very important in exploring the development mentality and model of the agricultural cooperation organizations.

articleTitle: Empirical study on the performance of T-M and H-M model-based China open-ended funds
abstract: As a result of the economic periods both before and after the 2008 global financial crisis, the fund displays a need for further independent and objective comprehensive analysis/empirical study. Based on these domestic and foreign research study results, statistical sampling, index analysis, and H-M/T-M model-based regression equations are utilized to make an empirical analysis on the performance of 15 partial (slant) stock open-ended funds established within the January 2003 to August 2010 economic cycle. The analysis reveals: 1) study results obtained without consideration to the weight of the risk profit index have a high correlation with the study results obtained using the three risk-adjustment method, 2) in conjunction with 1) above, the return rate of the China securities investment fund will outperform that of the market benchmark. Thus, the following conclusion is drawn: the Chinese fund managers are not on par security-selecting and market-handling ability.

articleTitle: Research and Modeling for the discipline of employment guidance for college graduates
abstract: The education and guidance at school not only affect college students' years when they are students but also affect their whole life. Therefore, it's extremely important to provide policy guidance, knowledge, experience and kill to enable college students to choose an occupation that may exert their capacity most according to their specific characters and social professional needs. This paper puts forward the conception of the discipline of employment guidance for college students, analyzes the formative background and research methods of this discipline, represents its talent cultivation target and principle, research contents, discipline model, teaching method, teaching evaluation, faculty building and others for employment guidance for college students. The conclusions and research prospects about the discipline of employment guidance for college students are also discussed in the end.

articleTitle: Study on the pricing of natural gas pipeline transportation based on the separate operation
abstract: According to the estimation by IEA, the natural gas can become the main energy by the middle of this century. Being a typical network industry, pipeline transportation has vertical integration characteristics. But in view of pipeline transportation' professional barrier, the domestic research into pipeline transportation integrated pricing is rare, even still blank in how to guarantee fairness between pipeline operators and other intermediate traders of natural gas. This paper studied the pricing question above, analyzed the price discrimination and non-price discrimination of pipeline inserted pricing, and finally constructed a natural gas pipeline transportation model which realized the non-price discrimination.

articleTitle: New exact solutions for Korteweg-de Vries Burgers equation and Korteweg-de Vries equation
abstract: To obtain new exact solutions for Korteweg-de Vries Burgers equation and Korteweg-de Vries equation, with the aid of symbolic computation, the Korteweg-de Vries Burgers equation and Korteweg-de Vries equation are investigated by using the trigonometric function transform method. More exact traveling wave solutions are obtained, and new exact traveling wave solutions are obtained for Korteweg-de Vries equation. The exact solutions for the nonlinear differential evolution equation are efficient and widely applicable.

articleTitle: The application research on process planning model of product development based on D-CPM Method
abstract: D-CPM Method is a dynamic process planning model which combines the product design tool with project management tool. D-CPM Method can solve the complex iterative problem which cannot be well described by traditional product development tools. First of all, the product development process is modeled by using DSM and then optimized by minimizing iterative. Afterwards, corresponding CPM network is built and the critical path is identified. Finally, the feasibility and efficiency of the proposed method is manifested by a case study.

articleTitle: Selection of re-manufacturing plant's location based on genetic algorithm
abstract: Re-manufacturing plant is the pivot of the reverse logistics system. So defining the location of is the key of reverse logistics system analysis. In this paper, according to the requirements and characteristics in the selection of the location, a mathematical model was established based on lowest transportation cost. Then genetic algorithm was used to solve the model, and the optimal solution of the model was obtained by selecting the encode method and genetic operator correctly. The proposed method is also applicable to the selection of the re-manufacturing plant's location in large-scale reverse logistics systems.

articleTitle: Research on the development of convergence business for telecom operators
abstract: The convergence business has become a new driving force to promote the growth of mobile users. In order to accelerate the development of convergence business, according to the characteristics of the convergence business, this paper designed a new convergence product, analyzed and elaborated the convergence business using Logistic functions and network externality theory, and predicted the development trend. The result shows that the convergence business will enter a stage of rapid development in the future.

articleTitle: Dynamic influence analysis of the CPI on ship maintenance hourly rate based on VAR model
abstract: Based on the yearly data from 1979 to 2009, the VAR model between CPI and ship maintenance hourly rate is established on the results of correlation, stationarity and cointegration test of the samples data. And then the Granger causality test, impulse response function and variance decomposition are applied into the dynamic analysis of the VAR model established in this paper. The empirical results show that there is a long-run equilibrium relationship between them. The CPI is the granger causality of the changes of hourly rate, and the reverse conclusion is also existed. A plus response would appear in time when the CPI changes and this influence has a long effect. The hourly rate is influenced by its inertia greatly in short-time, then the contributive percent from the CPI ascends rapidly to the degree which is equal to the degree of hourly rate inertia. The response of CPI to the change of hourly rate has one year lag, and the degree is also relatively insignificant to the inverse response. In the long term, the trace of hourly rate is ascending and fluctuating owing to the impact relations between CPI and hourly rate.

articleTitle: The research on self-innovation routing model of small and medium-sized enterprise
abstract: Small and medium-sized enterprises play an important role in developing national economy, which is significant for self-innovation improvement to study self-innovation routing. Based on improved model of chain-like joint proposed by S.J.Kline and N.Rosenberg, the chain-like joint model of self-innovation routing is constructed, which surmountes the problem of analyzing innovation behavior from the macroscopic view through traditional innovation routing theory and highlightes such characteristics as multi-agents, multi-routes, and property right valued. The countermeasures are put forward that self-innovation routing should be focused on cooperation, introduction, and industry chain.

articleTitle: Influencing factors of the industrial economic growth and its regional differences in China
abstract: Capital investment, labor input, financial investment and technological progress are factors that affecting the growth of industrial economy. In order to find the different effects on industrial economy, stimulating effects of these factors in east, central and western regions were estimated by using Cobb-Douglas production function. There are regional differences in the effects of the factors mentioned above. The main driving forces of China's industrial growth are still capital investment and labor input. The capital investment plays a larger role in the eastern and western regions, compared with the central region. The effect of public financial policy is not significant in the western region. The technological progress has not become the main driving force of China's industrial growth. Thus, the central region should increase the multiplier effect of the fixed asset investment, while the western region must improve the efficiency of fiscal spending through consolidated supervision.

articleTitle: The study on sub-sectors of small and medium-sized enterprises engaging in service outsourcing in Heilongjiang
abstract: The outsourcing service industry in Heilongjiang Province is booming in recent years. With the preferential policies and financial help, superior environment is created for small and medium-sized enterprises to develop service outsourcing business. On the basis of research on the influence factors of outsourcing services, an index system is built to evaluate development level of different sectors in order to select key outsourcing service industry. Studies show some main outsourcing service industries in Heilongjiang Province. And what's more, producer service outsourcing industries combining industrial foundation of Northeast old industrial base could be more competitive and have more promising potential.

articleTitle: Empirical study on relation between enterprise flexible strategy and competitiveness
abstract: While the business environment is becoming more and more uncertain, flexible strategy has become a strategic weapon for enterprises to use to create a lasting competitive advantage. This article divides the enterprise competitiveness into three essential factors: management capacity, financial capacity and market capacity. On this basis two modes are defined as using the flexible strategy and not using the flexible strategy, a theoretical model between the corporate strategy and competitive level is built as well. The empirical analysis concludes that flexible strategy has significant positive impacts on financial capacity and market capacity, which means there are significant positive impacts on enterprise's property scale, the main business income, productivity, market control, the brand effect, the research and development level, etc. However, there is no significantly impact on enterprise management capability.

articleTitle: Evaluation on virtual logistics enterprises competitiveness based on SEM
abstract: In order to evaluate competitiveness of virtual logistics enterprises in the process of logistics partner selection, establishing a scientific and suitable evaluation index system is the key step. This paper uses structural equation model (SEM), through an example, demonstrates the amending and optimized process for evaluation index system. Firstly an evaluation index system of competitiveness of VLE is established. Then use the SEM to amend and use the software LISREL to assignment the weights. Finally, apply this index system to appraisal competitiveness of virtual logistics enterprises. Suggestion and reference method are provided for logistics customer enterprises to build the evaluating indicator system.

articleTitle: Financing constraints and investment-cash flow sensitivity — Evidence from listed companies in China
abstract: This paper aims to investigate the impact of capital market imperfections on corporate investment. First, the paper constructs two synthetical indices that reflect the degree of financing constraints faced by Chinese listed companies, using Logistic Regression Model and Multiple Discriminant Analysis respectively. Second, the paper examines the relationship between financing constraints and the investment-cash flow sensitivity using OLS regressions. Empirical results show that corporate investments are sensitive to internally generated cash flows for all listed companies, but additional evidence shows that the investment-cash flow sensitivity of more financially constrained companies is significantly higher than that of less financially constrained companies. This paper provides evidence that the relationship between financing constraints and investment-cash flow sensitivity is monotonic, which is consistent with the findings of FHP(1988).

articleTitle: Bivariate exceedance model of relief factors of debris flow
abstract: In order to describe the extreme dependence structure of the two relief factors of debris flow of drainage area and drainage height difference, this paper studies the threshold selecting methods based on the mean residual life plot. The paper gets an accurate bivariate exceedance model which can better fit to the dependence structure of the data than the past works. The parameters in the model are calculated to get a specific joint distribution function and two marginal distribution functions, accordingly which give some extreme events probabilities.

articleTitle: Analyzing innovative model of the Small and Medium Enterprises financing: Supply chain financing
abstract: The Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) in the national economy play an irreplaceable role in solving the employment and achieving social stability. The credit is discriminative and the financing is difficult. The paper takes into account the interests of all parties, which is conducive to share the benefits. Supply chain financing addresses the difficulties of the small and medium enterprises financing, which provides an important way. The risks are researched in the process of implementation of supply chain financing models and preventive measures are given. Supply chain financing can have a huge space for development.

articleTitle: A brief understanding of quality variation a comparison of training programs in FOHs and COHs in China
abstract: One of the key elements for achieving service excellence in all service businesses is appropriate training. Organisational goals can not be reached without qualified trained staff. This paper seeks to compare and contrast hospitality training system practices of Chinese Owned Hotels (COHs) and Foreign Owned Hotels (FOHs) in the Chinese hotel industry. It's hoped to gain an understanding of the relative merits and deficiencies of both systems.

articleTitle: Applying combined AHP-QFD method in new product development: A case study in developing new sports earphone
abstract: Traditional QFD method does not prioritize the CRs. Applying AHP method in QFD can help represent and quantify the CRs, relate those elements to overall customer satisfaction goal and evaluate different design alternatives. The paper first discussed the concept of combined AHP-QFD approach in new product development, also used a new earphone development project as case study, and illustrated the steps in applying AHP method in determining the “Weights” of CRs. The paper showed how AHP method can be applied in a few other QFD elements. The implementation issues is discussed and AHP method is appropriate in developing new product.

articleTitle: Research on industrial cluster and competitive advantages
abstract: To enhance the competitiveness of enterprises, the paper analyzes relations between the industrial cluster and competitive advantage. Taking wenzhou industrial cluster as the case, the paper discusses the factors that contribute to the success. The clustered industry and the competitive advantage are closely related and affected each other. Finally the paper puts forward solutions to enhance the competitiveness.

articleTitle: The ship controller design based on RBF
abstract: A novel approach is promoted for fuzzy neural ship controllers. A RBF neural network and GA optimization are employed in a fuzzy neural controller to deal with the nonlinearity, time varying and uncertain factors. Utilizing the designed network to substitute the conventional fuzzy inference, the rule base and membership functions can be auto-adjusted by GA optimization. The parameters of neural network can be decreased by using union-rule configuration in the hidden layer of the network. The performance of controller is evaluated by the system simulation conducted with Simulink tools, by which satisfied results have been obtained.

articleTitle: Study on the support of human resource for international service outsourcing in Jilin province
abstract: Human resource is the most important factor in the international service outsourcing, and good human resource is the key condition to undertake international service outsourcing successfully. Based on the analysis on the support of human resource for the international service outsourcing this paper establishes an indicator system. According to statistical data, the paper uses the principal component analysis to evaluate the support of human resource for the development of international service outsourcing. It shows that the support is weak in Jilin province. It is essential for Jilin province to train and introduce talents in order to further develop the ability to undertake international service outsourcing.
